CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_original_security()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
        BEGIN
          IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original security history cannot be deleted';
          ELSIF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
            IF NEW.epoch <> 1 OR NEW.current_request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
              RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original security begins without a scan fact';
            END IF;
          ELSIF ROW(NEW.id,NEW.tenant_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.original_id,NEW.created_at)
                IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.tenant_id,OLD.product_id,OLD.original_id,OLD.created_at)
                OR NEW.epoch <> OLD.epoch + 1
                OR (OLD.source_state = 'withdrawn' AND NEW.source_state <> 'withdrawn') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original protection epoch must advance without reviving withdrawn sources';
          END IF;
          IF NEW.current_request_id IS NOT NULL AND
             (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR NEW.current_request_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.current_request_id)
             AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM original_scan_requests r
                             WHERE r.id=NEW.current_request_id AND r.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
                               AND r.product_id=NEW.product_id AND r.original_id=NEW.original_id
                               AND r.revision=NEW.epoch) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Scan pointer must bind the current protection epoch';
          END IF;
          RETURN NEW;
        END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_formal_verification_binding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
      DECLARE prep verification_preparations%ROWTYPE;
              previous verification_formal_requests%ROWTYPE;
      BEGIN
        SELECT * INTO prep FROM verification_preparations WHERE id=NEW.preparation_id
          AND tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND product_id=NEW.product_id;
        IF NOT FOUND OR ROW(NEW.project_id,NEW.build_id,NEW.build_revision,
            NEW.preparation_revision,NEW.preparation_sha256)
          IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(prep.project_id,prep.build_id,prep.build_revision,
            prep.revision,prep.snapshot_sha256) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Formal request must bind the exact preparation';
        END IF;
        IF ROW(NEW.request_snapshot->>'id',NEW.request_snapshot->>'revision',
            NEW.request_snapshot->'scope'->>'tenant_id',
            NEW.request_snapshot->'scope'->>'product_id',
            NEW.request_snapshot->'scope'->>'project_id')
          IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.request_id::text,NEW.revision::text,
            NEW.tenant_id::text,NEW.product_id::text,NEW.project_id::text)
          OR NEW.request_snapshot->'build' IS DISTINCT FROM prep.request_snapshot->'build'
          OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.request_snapshot->'timeline'->'request_created')
            IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Formal request snapshot must preserve exact identity and configuration';
        END IF;
        IF NEW.revision=1 THEN
          IF NEW.operation<>'verification.request.create' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'First formal request requires creation';
          END IF;
        ELSE
          SELECT * INTO previous FROM verification_formal_requests
            WHERE id=NEW.previous_request_id AND tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
              AND product_id=NEW.product_id;
          IF NOT FOUND OR ROW(NEW.project_id,NEW.build_id,NEW.build_revision,
              NEW.request_id,NEW.owner_id,NEW.visibility,NEW.preparation_id,
              NEW.preparation_revision,NEW.preparation_sha256,NEW.purpose,NEW.previous_revision)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(previous.project_id,previous.build_id,previous.build_revision,
              previous.request_id,previous.owner_id,previous.visibility,previous.preparation_id,
              previous.preparation_revision,previous.preparation_sha256,
              previous.purpose,previous.revision)
            OR NEW.request_snapshot->'timeline'->'request_created' IS DISTINCT FROM
              previous.request_snapshot->'timeline'->'request_created'
            OR NEW.operation='verification.request.create' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Formal request successor must retain its fixed history';
          END IF;
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_build_start_binding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
      DECLARE assessment build_execution_assessments%ROWTYPE;
              eng build_authorization_decisions%ROWTYPE; mfg build_authorization_decisions%ROWTYPE;
      BEGIN
        SELECT * INTO assessment FROM build_execution_assessments WHERE id=NEW.assessment_id
          AND tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND product_id=NEW.product_id;
        SELECT * INTO eng FROM build_authorization_decisions WHERE id=NEW.engineering_authorization_id
          AND tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND product_id=NEW.product_id;
        SELECT * INTO mfg FROM build_authorization_decisions WHERE id=NEW.manufacturing_authorization_id
          AND tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND product_id=NEW.product_id;
        IF assessment.id IS NULL OR eng.id IS NULL OR mfg.id IS NULL
          OR NEW.assessment_sha256<>assessment.snapshot_sha256
          OR NEW.build_revision<>assessment.build_revision
          OR NEW.execution_scope IS DISTINCT FROM assessment.execution_scope
          OR eng.assessment_id<>assessment.id OR mfg.assessment_id<>assessment.id
          OR eng.status<>'approved' OR mfg.status<>'approved'
          OR NEW.occurred_at>clock_timestamp()
          OR NEW.occurred_at<eng.created_at OR NEW.occurred_at<mfg.created_at
          OR NEW.occurred_at<(NEW.execution_scope->>'window_start')::timestamptz
          OR NEW.occurred_at>=(NEW.execution_scope->>'window_end')::timestamptz
          OR LEAST(eng.valid_until,mfg.valid_until)<(NEW.execution_scope->>'window_end')::timestamptz
          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM build_current_execution_assessments p
            WHERE p.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND p.build_id=NEW.build_id AND p.assessment_id=assessment.id)
          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM build_current_authorizations p
            WHERE p.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND p.build_id=NEW.build_id AND p.role='engineering' AND p.decision_id=eng.id)
          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM build_current_authorizations p
            WHERE p.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND p.build_id=NEW.build_id AND p.role='manufacturing' AND p.decision_id=mfg.id)
          THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Start requires current matching approvals and actual occurrence'; END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_verification_run_binding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
      DECLARE identity verification_run_identities%ROWTYPE; prior verification_run_versions%ROWTYPE;
      BEGIN
        SELECT * INTO identity FROM verification_run_identities WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.run_id;
        IF identity.id IS NULL OR ROW(NEW.product_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.build_id,NEW.request_id,NEW.owner_id,NEW.visibility)
          IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(identity.product_id,identity.project_id,identity.build_id,identity.request_id,identity.owner_id,identity.visibility)
          OR NEW.run_snapshot->>'id'<>NEW.run_id::text OR (NEW.run_snapshot->>'revision')::int<>NEW.revision OR NEW.run_snapshot->>'status'<>NEW.status THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Run version must retain exact identity and snapshot'; END IF;
        IF NEW.revision>1 THEN
          SELECT * INTO prior FROM verification_run_versions WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.previous_run_version_id;
          IF prior.id IS NULL OR ROW(NEW.request_version_id,NEW.request_revision,NEW.plan_sha256,NEW.execution_plan)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(prior.request_version_id,prior.request_revision,prior.plan_sha256,prior.execution_plan)
            OR NEW.run_snapshot->'coverage' IS DISTINCT FROM prior.run_snapshot->'coverage'
            OR NEW.run_snapshot->'items' IS DISTINCT FROM prior.run_snapshot->'items'
            OR NEW.run_snapshot->'samples' IS DISTINCT FROM prior.run_snapshot->'samples'
            OR NEW.previous_revision<>prior.revision OR NEW.revision<>prior.revision+1
            OR NEW.run_snapshot->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM prior.run_snapshot->'scope'
            OR NEW.run_snapshot->'build' IS DISTINCT FROM prior.run_snapshot->'build'
            OR NEW.run_snapshot->>'request_id' IS DISTINCT FROM prior.run_snapshot->>'request_id'
            OR NEW.input_snapshot->'plan_binding' IS DISTINCT FROM prior.input_snapshot->'plan_binding'
            OR (NEW.revision>2 AND (
              NEW.run_snapshot->'actual_start' IS DISTINCT FROM prior.run_snapshot->'actual_start'
              OR NEW.run_snapshot->'execution' IS DISTINCT FROM prior.run_snapshot->'execution'
              OR NEW.input_snapshot->'reservation' IS DISTINCT FROM prior.input_snapshot->'reservation'
              OR NOT COALESCE((NEW.run_snapshot->'measurements') @> (prior.run_snapshot->'measurements'),false)))
     THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Started Run cannot rewrite fixed plan or coverage'; END IF;
        END IF;
        IF NEW.status='running' AND ((NEW.run_snapshot->'actual_start'->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz>clock_timestamp()
          OR (NEW.run_snapshot->'actual_start'->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz<(NEW.execution_plan->'window'->>'start')::timestamptz
          OR (NEW.run_snapshot->'actual_start'->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz>=(NEW.execution_plan->'window'->>'finish')::timestamptz) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Actual test start must lie within fixed resource window'; END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_test_run_atom(tid uuid, rid uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
      DECLARE run verification_run_versions%ROWTYPE; reservation test_resource_reservations%ROWTYPE;
      BEGIN
        SELECT * INTO run FROM verification_run_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid AND run_id=rid AND revision=2 AND operation='test.run.start' AND status='running';
        IF run.id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verification_launch_facts f
          JOIN verification_formal_requests q ON q.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND q.id=f.next_request_version_id
          WHERE f.tenant_id=tid AND f.run_version_id=run.id AND f.operation='test.run.start'
          AND q.status='executing' AND q.request_id=run.request_id) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Every test use requires its exact actual Run and request start'; END IF;
        SELECT * INTO reservation FROM test_resource_reservations WHERE tenant_id=tid AND run_id=rid;
        IF reservation.id IS NULL OR ROW(reservation.product_id,reservation.project_id,reservation.build_id,reservation.intent_digest)
          IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(run.product_id,run.project_id,run.build_id,run.intent_digest)
          OR reservation.binding IS DISTINCT FROM run.input_snapshot->'plan_binding' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Actual Run must retain exact resource reservation binding'; END IF;
        IF (SELECT array_agg(u.sample_id::text ORDER BY u.sample_id::text) FROM sample_run_usages u WHERE u.tenant_id=tid AND u.run_id=rid)
          IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT array_agg(v->>'id' ORDER BY v->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(run.run_snapshot->'samples') v) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Actual Run requires its exact complete physical sample set'; END IF;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sample_run_usages u WHERE u.tenant_id=tid AND u.run_id=rid AND (
          ROW(u.product_id,u.project_id,u.build_id,u.intent_digest,u.window_start,u.window_finish)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(run.product_id,run.project_id,run.build_id,run.intent_digest,
              (run.execution_plan->'window'->>'start')::timestamptz,(run.execution_plan->'window'->>'finish')::timestamptz)
          OR (SELECT jsonb_agg(c ORDER BY c->>'sample_id',c->>'item_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(u.coverage) c)
            IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT jsonb_agg(c ORDER BY c->>'sample_id',c->>'item_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(run.run_snapshot->'coverage') c WHERE c->>'sample_id'=u.sample_id::text)
          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(run.run_snapshot->'samples') v WHERE
            v->>'id'=u.sample_id::text AND (v->>'revision')::int=u.sample_revision
            AND v->'actual_configuration'->>'id'=u.actual_configuration_id::text
            AND (v->'actual_configuration'->>'revision')::int=u.actual_configuration_revision)
          OR u.destructive IS DISTINCT FROM EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(run.run_snapshot->'items') i
            JOIN jsonb_array_elements(u.coverage) c ON c->>'item_id'=i->>'id' WHERE (i->>'destructive')::boolean)
          OR u.source_basis->'actual_start'->'source' IS DISTINCT FROM run.run_snapshot->'actual_start'->'source'
          OR (u.source_basis->'actual_start'->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (run.run_snapshot->'actual_start'->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz)) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sample use must match exact Run coverage, configuration, event and window'; END IF;
        IF (SELECT count(*) FROM operational_resource_occupancies o WHERE o.tenant_id=tid AND o.test_run_id=rid)
          <>jsonb_array_length(reservation.reservation->'request'->'uses') OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM operational_resource_occupancies o WHERE o.tenant_id=tid AND o.test_run_id=rid AND (
            ROW(o.product_id,o.project_id,o.build_id,o.intent_digest,o.window_start,o.window_finish)
              IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(run.product_id,run.project_id,run.build_id,run.intent_digest,
                (run.execution_plan->'window'->>'start')::timestamptz,(run.execution_plan->'window'->>'finish')::timestamptz)
            OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(reservation.reservation->'request'->'uses') v WHERE
              v->'resource'->>'id'=o.resource_id::text AND (v->'resource'->>'revision')::int=o.resource_revision
              AND (v->>'units')::numeric=o.units))) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Every test resource occupancy must match its exact full-window use'; END IF;
      END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_test_result_atom(tid uuid, version_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
      DECLARE target verification_run_versions%ROWTYPE; prior verification_run_versions%ROWTYPE;
              fact test_result_actions%ROWTYPE; report test_result_projections%ROWTYPE;
              request_before verification_formal_requests%ROWTYPE; request_after verification_formal_requests%ROWTYPE;
      BEGIN
        SELECT * INTO target FROM verification_run_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=version_id;
        SELECT * INTO prior FROM verification_run_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=target.previous_run_version_id;
        SELECT * INTO fact FROM test_result_actions WHERE tenant_id=tid AND next_run_version_id=target.id;
        IF target.id IS NULL OR prior.id IS NULL OR fact.id IS NULL OR target.revision<3
          OR ROW(fact.product_id,fact.project_id,fact.build_id,fact.request_id,fact.run_id,fact.operation,
                 fact.run_version_id,fact.run_revision,fact.next_run_revision,fact.actor_id)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(target.product_id,target.project_id,target.build_id,target.request_id,
                 target.run_id,target.operation,prior.id,prior.revision,target.revision,target.writer_id)
          OR fact.intent_digest IS DISTINCT FROM target.intent_digest THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Result successor requires its exact named action and previous Run'; END IF;
        SELECT * INTO request_before FROM verification_formal_requests WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=fact.request_version_id;
        SELECT * INTO request_after FROM verification_formal_requests WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=fact.next_request_version_id;
        IF request_before.id IS NULL OR request_after.id IS NULL
          OR ROW(request_before.product_id,request_before.project_id,request_before.build_id,request_before.request_id,request_before.revision)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(target.product_id,target.project_id,target.build_id,target.request_id,fact.request_revision)
          OR ROW(request_after.product_id,request_after.project_id,request_after.build_id,request_after.request_id,request_after.revision)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(target.product_id,target.project_id,target.build_id,target.request_id,fact.next_request_revision)
          OR (request_after.id<>request_before.id AND (
            request_after.previous_request_id IS DISTINCT FROM request_before.id
            OR request_after.previous_revision<>request_before.revision OR request_after.operation<>target.operation)) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Result action must retain its exact request transition'; END IF;
        IF (target.operation='test.results.import' AND (prior.status<>'running' OR target.status NOT IN ('running','results_pending')))
          OR (target.operation='test.run.review' AND (prior.status<>'results_pending' OR target.status<>'reviewed'))
          OR (target.operation='test.disposition.decide' AND (prior.status<>'reviewed' OR target.status<>'disposed')) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Result action must preserve import/review/disposition order'; END IF;
        IF target.operation<>'test.results.import' AND (
          (target.run_snapshot - 'revision' - 'status' - 'professional_conclusion' - 'disposition')
            IS DISTINCT FROM (prior.run_snapshot - 'revision' - 'status' - 'professional_conclusion' - 'disposition')
          OR (target.operation='test.disposition.decide' AND target.run_snapshot->'professional_conclusion'
            IS DISTINCT FROM prior.run_snapshot->'professional_conclusion')) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Professional text cannot rewrite raw measurements or numerical results'; END IF;
        SELECT * INTO report FROM test_result_projections WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=fact.projection_id;
        IF report.id IS NULL OR ROW(report.product_id,report.project_id,report.build_id,report.request_id,report.run_id)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(target.product_id,target.project_id,target.build_id,target.request_id,target.run_id)
          OR report.result IS DISTINCT FROM target.run_snapshot->>'result'
          OR report.computed_results IS DISTINCT FROM target.run_snapshot->'computed_results'
          OR (target.operation='test.results.import' AND report.run_version_id IS DISTINCT FROM target.id) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Result action requires its exact immutable computed projection'; END IF;
        IF (SELECT count(*) FROM test_measurements m WHERE m.tenant_id=tid AND m.run_id=target.run_id)
            <>jsonb_array_length(target.run_snapshot->'measurements') OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(target.run_snapshot->'measurements') value WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM test_measurements m WHERE m.tenant_id=tid AND m.run_id=target.run_id
              AND m.id::text=value->>'id' AND m.measurement=value)) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Run measurements must equal the exact immutable physical pair records'; END IF;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM action_receipts r WHERE r.tenant_id=tid
          AND r.product_id=target.product_id AND r.operation=target.operation
          AND r.subject_id=target.id AND r.subject_revision=target.revision AND r.actor_id=fact.actor_id) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Result action requires its exact common receipt'; END IF;
        PERFORM assert_test_run_atom(tid,target.run_id);
      END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_test_result_binding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
      DECLARE target verification_run_versions%ROWTYPE; capture measurement_import_captures%ROWTYPE;
      BEGIN
        SELECT * INTO target FROM verification_run_versions WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.run_version_id;
        IF target.id IS NULL OR ROW(NEW.product_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.build_id,NEW.request_id,NEW.run_id,NEW.run_revision)
          IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(target.product_id,target.project_id,target.build_id,target.request_id,target.run_id,target.revision) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Result object must bind exact fixed Run scope'; END IF;
        IF TG_TABLE_NAME='test_measurements' THEN
          SELECT * INTO capture FROM measurement_import_captures WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.capture_id;
          IF capture.id IS NULL OR capture.product_id<>NEW.product_id OR capture.run_id<>NEW.run_id
            OR capture.run_version_id IS DISTINCT FROM target.previous_run_version_id
            OR NEW.measurement->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id::text
            OR NEW.measurement->'coverage'->>'sample_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.sample_id::text
            OR NEW.measurement->'coverage'->>'item_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.item_id
            OR NEW.verified_observation->'measurement' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.measurement
            OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(target.run_snapshot->'measurements') v WHERE v=NEW.measurement)
            OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(target.run_snapshot->'samples') v WHERE
              v->>'id'=NEW.sample_id::text AND (v->>'revision')::int=NEW.sample_revision
              AND v->'actual_configuration'->>'id'=NEW.actual_configuration_id::text
              AND (v->'actual_configuration'->>'revision')::int=NEW.actual_configuration_revision) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Measurement must bind exact capture, original values and physical configuration'; END IF;
        ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='test_result_projections' THEN
          IF NEW.run_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM target.snapshot_sha256 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Projection must bind exact immutable Run snapshot'; END IF;
        ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='measurement_import_captures' THEN
          IF NEW.run_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM target.snapshot_sha256 OR target.status<>'running' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Capture must bind exact running Run snapshot'; END IF;
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_quality_change_receipt(tid uuid, pid uuid, sid uuid, rev integer, op_name text, subject_name text, actor uuid, audience text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE receipt action_receipts%ROWTYPE; expected_event text;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO receipt FROM action_receipts WHERE tenant_id=tid AND product_id=pid
    AND subject_id=sid AND subject_revision=rev AND operation=op_name
    AND subject_type=subject_name AND actor_id=actor AND requester_id=actor AND run_id IS NULL
    AND visibility=audience;
  expected_event := CASE op_name
    WHEN 'quality.issue.create' THEN 'issue.created'
    WHEN 'quality.issue.merge' THEN 'issues.merged'
    WHEN 'quality.issue.triage' THEN 'issue.triaged'
    WHEN 'quality.issue.containment.record' THEN 'issue.contained'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.draft' THEN 'capa.drafted'
    WHEN 'quality.policy.import' THEN 'quality.policy_imported'
    WHEN 'change.request.create' THEN 'change.requested'
    WHEN 'change.impact.compute' THEN 'change.impact_created'
    WHEN 'change.order.prepare' THEN 'change.order_prepared'
    WHEN 'change.order.approve' THEN 'change.approved'
    WHEN 'change.implementation.record' THEN 'change.implementation_recorded'
    WHEN 'quality.issue.root_cause.decide' THEN 'issue.root_cause_decided'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.actions.complete' THEN 'capa.actions_completed'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.followup.link' THEN 'capa.followup_linked'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.rule.import' THEN 'CapaVerificationRulePublished'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.observation.record' THEN 'CapaObservationRecorded'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.review' THEN 'CapaVerificationReviewed'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.candidate.record' THEN 'CapaVerificationCandidateRecorded' END;
  IF receipt.id IS NULL OR expected_event IS NULL
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM action_receipts WHERE tenant_id=tid AND product_id=pid
      AND subject_id=sid AND subject_revision=rev AND operation=op_name)<>1
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_entries WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=receipt.id)<>1
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_entries WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=receipt.id
      AND actor_id=actor AND operation=op_name)
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_events WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=receipt.id)<>1
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox_events WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=receipt.id
      AND type=expected_event AND actor_id=actor AND subject_id=sid AND subject_revision=rev
      AND correlation_id=receipt.command_id AND schema_version=1) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quality/change write requires exactly one named receipt, audit and event';
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_quality_policy_current()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE target quality_policy_facts%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Policy series pointer cannot be deleted'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO target FROM quality_policy_facts WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.fact_id;
  IF target.id IS NULL OR ROW(target.product_id,target.project_id,target.purpose,target.series_id,
    target.revision,target.issuer_key,target.external_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
    ROW(NEW.product_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.purpose,NEW.series_id,NEW.fact_revision,
      NEW.issuer_key,NEW.external_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Policy current requires its exact scoped fact'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.fact_revision<>1 OR NEW.epoch<>1 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Policy series starts at revision and epoch one'; END IF;
  ELSE
    IF ROW(NEW.id,NEW.tenant_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.purpose,NEW.series_id,
      NEW.issuer_key,NEW.external_id,NEW.created_at) IS DISTINCT FROM
      ROW(OLD.id,OLD.tenant_id,OLD.product_id,OLD.project_id,OLD.purpose,OLD.series_id,
        OLD.issuer_key,OLD.external_id,OLD.created_at)
      OR NEW.fact_revision<>OLD.fact_revision+1 OR NEW.epoch<>OLD.epoch+1
      OR target.previous_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.fact_id
      OR target.previous_revision IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.fact_revision THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Policy pointer requires a continuous exact predecessor'; END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_quality_failure_alias()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE target quality_issue_versions%ROWTYPE; source quality_issue_versions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Failure identity cannot be deleted'; END IF;
  SELECT v.* INTO target FROM quality_current_issues c JOIN quality_issue_versions v
    ON v.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND v.id=c.issue_version_id
    WHERE c.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND c.product_id=NEW.product_id
      AND c.project_id=NEW.project_id AND c.issue_id=NEW.issue_id;
  IF target.id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(target.issue_snapshot->'failures') f
      WHERE f=NEW.failure) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Failure alias requires the exact retained failure in its current Issue'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.epoch<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Failure identity starts at epoch one'; END IF;
  ELSE
    SELECT v.* INTO source FROM quality_current_issues c JOIN quality_issue_versions v
      ON v.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND v.id=c.issue_version_id
      WHERE c.tenant_id=OLD.tenant_id AND c.product_id=OLD.product_id
        AND c.project_id=OLD.project_id AND c.issue_id=OLD.issue_id;
    IF ROW(NEW.id,NEW.tenant_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.failure_identity,NEW.failure,NEW.created_at)
      IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.tenant_id,OLD.product_id,OLD.project_id,OLD.failure_identity,OLD.failure,OLD.created_at)
      OR NEW.issue_id=OLD.issue_id OR NEW.epoch<>OLD.epoch+1 OR source.id IS NULL
      OR source.operation<>'quality.issue.merge' OR target.operation<>'quality.issue.merge'
      OR source.intent_digest<>target.intent_digest
      OR source.issue_snapshot->>'merged_into' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.issue_id::text THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Failure alias can move only through the exact preserved merge'; END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_quality_change_atom()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE target quality_issue_versions%ROWTYPE; prior quality_issue_versions%ROWTYPE;
  merge_source quality_issue_versions%ROWTYPE; selected jsonb;
  change_before change_request_versions%ROWTYPE; capture change_graph_captures%ROWTYPE;
  receipt action_receipts%ROWTYPE; event outbox_events%ROWTYPE; projection test_result_projections%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='quality_issue_versions' THEN
    target := NEW;
    IF (NEW.revision=1 AND NEW.operation<>'quality.issue.create')
      OR (NEW.revision>1 AND NEW.operation='quality.issue.create')
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quality_current_issues c WHERE c.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
        AND c.issue_version_id=NEW.id AND c.issue_revision=NEW.revision) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Issue version must be the exact canonical creation or successor'; END IF;
    IF NEW.previous_issue_version_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT * INTO prior FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.previous_issue_version_id;
      IF prior.id IS NULL OR ROW(prior.product_id,prior.project_id,prior.issue_id,prior.owner_id,prior.visibility,prior.purpose)
        IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.product_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.issue_id,NEW.owner_id,NEW.visibility,NEW.purpose)
        OR prior.revision<>NEW.previous_revision THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Issue successor must retain its exact owner, audience and scope'; END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.operation='quality.issue.merge' THEN
      SELECT * INTO target FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
        AND product_id=NEW.product_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id
        AND issue_id::text=NEW.input_snapshot->>'issue_id' AND operation=NEW.operation
        AND intent_digest=NEW.intent_digest AND writer_id=NEW.writer_id;
      IF target.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Merge requires one exact target version'; END IF;
      IF COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(target.input_snapshot->'sources'),'')<>'array'
        OR COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(target.input_snapshot->'sources'),0) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 30
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(target.input_snapshot->'sources') r
          WHERE r->>'id'=target.issue_id::text)
        OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT r->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(target.input_snapshot->'sources') r)
          <>jsonb_array_length(target.input_snapshot->'sources')
        OR (NEW.id<>target.id AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(target.input_snapshot->'sources') r
          WHERE r->>'id'=NEW.issue_id::text AND (r->>'revision')::integer=NEW.previous_revision)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Merge requires explicit unique sources and only its exact listed successors'; END IF;
      IF target.previous_revision IS DISTINCT FROM
        (target.input_snapshot->>'expected_issue_revision')::integer THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Merge must retain its exact target precondition'; END IF;
      FOR selected IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(target.input_snapshot->'sources') LOOP
        SELECT * INTO merge_source FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=target.tenant_id
          AND product_id=target.product_id AND project_id=target.project_id
          AND issue_id::text=selected->>'id' AND previous_revision=(selected->>'revision')::integer
          AND revision=(selected->>'revision')::integer+1 AND operation=target.operation
          AND intent_digest=target.intent_digest AND writer_id=target.writer_id;
        IF merge_source.id IS NULL
          OR merge_source.issue_snapshot->>'merged_into' IS DISTINCT FROM target.issue_id::text
          OR NOT COALESCE((target.issue_snapshot->'failures') @> (merge_source.issue_snapshot->'failures'),false)
          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quality_current_issues c WHERE c.tenant_id=target.tenant_id
            AND c.issue_version_id=merge_source.id AND c.issue_revision=merge_source.revision) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Merge must preserve every exact source successor and failure'; END IF;
      END LOOP;
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(target.issue_snapshot->'failures') f
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quality_failure_maps m WHERE m.tenant_id=target.tenant_id
          AND m.product_id=target.product_id AND m.project_id=target.project_id
          AND m.issue_id=target.issue_id AND m.failure=f)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Merge requires all stable failure aliases to retain their exact target'; END IF;
    END IF;
    PERFORM assert_quality_change_receipt(target.tenant_id,target.product_id,target.id,target.revision,
      target.operation,'quality_issue',target.writer_id,target.visibility);
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='quality_policy_facts' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quality_current_policies c WHERE c.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
      AND c.fact_id=NEW.id AND c.fact_revision=NEW.revision) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Policy fact requires its exact canonical series pointer'; END IF;
    PERFORM assert_quality_change_receipt(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.id,NEW.revision,
      'quality.policy.import','quality_policy_fact',NEW.owner_id,NEW.visibility);
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='change_request_versions' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM change_request_currents c WHERE c.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
      AND c.version_id=NEW.id AND c.revision=NEW.revision)
      OR (NEW.operation='change.request.create' AND (NEW.revision<>1
        OR NEW.request_snapshot->'assessments' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb))
      OR (NEW.operation='change.impact.compute' AND NEW.revision<2) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Change creation and impact must advance the exact canonical pointer'; END IF;
    IF NEW.previous_version_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT * INTO change_before FROM change_request_versions WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.previous_version_id;
      IF change_before.id IS NULL OR ROW(change_before.product_id,change_before.project_id,change_before.change_id,
        change_before.owner_id,change_before.visibility) IS DISTINCT FROM
        ROW(NEW.product_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.change_id,NEW.owner_id,NEW.visibility)
        OR change_before.revision<>NEW.previous_revision THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Change successor must retain exact owner, audience and scope'; END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.operation='change.impact.compute' THEN
      SELECT * INTO capture FROM change_graph_captures WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
        AND id::text=(NEW.request_snapshot->'assessments'->-1)->'graph'->>'id';
      IF capture.id IS NULL OR ROW(capture.product_id,capture.project_id,capture.change_id,
        capture.change_version_id,capture.change_revision) IS DISTINCT FROM
        ROW(NEW.product_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.change_id,NEW.previous_version_id,NEW.previous_revision)
        OR capture.graph_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.request_snapshot->'assessments'->-1)->'graph'
        OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.request_snapshot->'assessments')
          <>jsonb_array_length(change_before.request_snapshot->'assessments')+1
        OR ((NEW.request_snapshot->'assessments')
          - (jsonb_array_length(NEW.request_snapshot->'assessments')-1))
          IS DISTINCT FROM (change_before.request_snapshot->'assessments')
        OR capture.expires_at<=NEW.created_at THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Impact successor requires its exact unexpired committed graph capture'; END IF;
    END IF;
    PERFORM assert_quality_change_receipt(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.id,NEW.revision,
      NEW.operation,'change_request',(NEW.authority_snapshot->>'subject_id')::uuid,NEW.visibility);
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='quality_event_failure_links' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quality_issue_versions v,
      LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(v.issue_snapshot->'failures') f
      WHERE v.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND v.id=NEW.issue_version_id
        AND (f-'run')=(NEW.failure-'run') AND f->'run'->>'id'=NEW.run_id::text) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Event delivery must retain the stable failure and its actual event Run revision'; END IF;
    SELECT * INTO event FROM outbox_events WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.event_id;
    SELECT * INTO receipt FROM action_receipts WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=event.receipt_id;
    SELECT * INTO projection FROM test_result_projections WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.projection_id;
    IF receipt.id IS NULL OR receipt.product_id<>NEW.product_id OR event.subject_id<>receipt.subject_id
      OR event.subject_revision<>receipt.subject_revision OR event.actor_id<>receipt.actor_id
      OR event.schema_version<>1 OR event.correlation_id<>receipt.command_id
      OR projection.basis_sha256<>NEW.basis_sha256
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(projection.computed_results) r
        WHERE r->>'measurement_id'=NEW.measurement_id::text AND r->>'result'='fail')
      OR NOT ((receipt.operation='test.result.compute' AND receipt.subject_type='test_result_projection'
          AND receipt.subject_id=NEW.projection_id AND receipt.subject_revision=NEW.projection_revision
          AND event.type='test.result_computed' AND projection.run_version_id=NEW.run_version_id)
        OR (receipt.operation IN ('test.results.import','test.run.review','test.disposition.decide')
          AND receipt.subject_type='test_run' AND receipt.subject_id=NEW.run_version_id
          AND receipt.subject_revision=NEW.run_revision
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_result_actions a WHERE a.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
            AND a.product_id=NEW.product_id AND a.project_id=NEW.project_id
            AND a.build_id=NEW.build_id AND a.request_id=NEW.request_id AND a.run_id=NEW.run_id
            AND a.next_run_version_id=NEW.run_version_id AND a.next_run_revision=NEW.run_revision
            AND a.operation=receipt.operation AND a.projection_id=NEW.projection_id)
          AND event.type=CASE receipt.operation WHEN 'test.results.import' THEN 'test.results_imported'
            WHEN 'test.run.review' THEN 'test.run_reviewed' ELSE 'test.disposition_decided' END)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Failure link requires its exact actual result event and fixed failing projection'; END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_quality_followup_proof(tid uuid, pid uuid, actor uuid, op_name text, proof jsonb, saved_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS confirmations
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE c confirmations%ROWTYPE; expected_tier text; uses integer;
BEGIN
  expected_tier := CASE op_name WHEN 'quality.issue.root_cause.decide' THEN 'T2'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.actions.complete' THEN 'T1' WHEN 'quality.capa.followup.link' THEN 'T1'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.observation.record' THEN 'T1'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.review' THEN 'T2'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.candidate.record' THEN 'T1' END;
  IF expected_tier IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(proof->>'tier'=expected_tier AND
    proof->>'id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$',false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup requires its exact shared proof tier and identity'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO c FROM confirmations WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=(proof->>'id')::uuid;
  IF c.id IS NULL OR ROW(c.product_id,c.subject_id,c.actor_id,c.operation)
    IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(pid,pid,actor,op_name) OR c.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM true
    OR c.revision IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT revision FROM products WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=pid)
    OR c.expires_at<=saved_at OR c.created_at>saved_at
    OR NOT COALESCE(c.payload_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND c.token_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      AND jsonb_typeof(c.snapshot)='object',false)
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM principals WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=actor AND kind='human' AND active) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup requires a consumed current Product proof by the named human'; END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO uses FROM (
    SELECT id FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid AND operation IN
      ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete')
      AND source_basis->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
    UNION ALL SELECT id FROM capa_remediation_links WHERE tenant_id=tid
      AND input_snapshot->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
    UNION ALL SELECT id FROM capa_observation_facts WHERE tenant_id=tid AND shared_proof_id=c.id
    UNION ALL SELECT id FROM capa_named_verification_reviews WHERE tenant_id=tid AND shared_proof_id=c.id
    UNION ALL SELECT id FROM capa_verification_evidence WHERE tenant_id=tid
      AND input_snapshot->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
  ) u;
  IF uses<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'One consumed proof must bind exactly one new followup target'; END IF;
  -- The reciprocal deferred transition guard and immutable consumed rows pair
  -- this target with a real False->True transition in the same UOW. No xmin/top
  -- xid assumption is used, so a legitimate SAVEPOINT remains supported.
  -- Python canonical material/token digests and runtime freshness still require
  -- quality_followup_host's actual marker; JSONB text hashing is not equivalent.
  RETURN c;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_quality_followup_receipt(tid uuid, pid uuid, sid uuid, rev integer, op_name text, subject_name text, actor uuid, audience text, expected_status text)
 RETURNS action_receipts
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE r action_receipts%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  PERFORM assert_quality_change_receipt(tid,pid,sid,rev,op_name,subject_name,actor,audience);
  SELECT * INTO r FROM action_receipts WHERE tenant_id=tid AND product_id=pid AND subject_id=sid
    AND subject_revision=rev AND operation=op_name AND subject_type=subject_name;
  IF NOT COALESCE(r.result->>'id'=sid::text AND (r.result->>'revision')::integer=rev
    AND r.result->>'status'=expected_status,false)
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM request_keys WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=r.id)<>1
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM request_keys WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=r.id
      AND actor_id=actor AND digest=r.request_digest) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup requires its exact result and one initial request-key receipt group'; END IF;
  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_quality_followup_consumption_atom()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE c confirmations%ROWTYPE; uses integer; matched integer;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.operation NOT IN
    ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete','quality.capa.followup.link','quality.capa.observation.record','quality.capa.verification.review','quality.capa.verification.candidate.record') THEN
    RETURN NULL; END IF;
  IF OLD.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM false OR NEW.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup proof requires an actual consumption transition'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO c FROM confirmations WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.id;
  IF c.id IS NULL OR to_jsonb(c) IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Consumed followup proof cannot disappear or change before commit'; END IF;
  SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE product_id=c.product_id AND writer_id=c.actor_id
    AND operation=c.operation) INTO uses,matched FROM (
    SELECT product_id,writer_id,operation FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id
      AND operation IN ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete')
      AND source_basis->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
    UNION ALL SELECT product_id,writer_id,'quality.capa.followup.link'::text AS operation
      FROM capa_remediation_links WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id
      AND input_snapshot->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
    UNION ALL SELECT product_id,writer_id,operation FROM capa_observation_facts
      WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND shared_proof_id=c.id
    UNION ALL SELECT product_id,writer_id,operation FROM capa_named_verification_reviews
      WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND shared_proof_id=c.id
    UNION ALL SELECT product_id,writer_id,'quality.capa.verification.candidate.record'::text
      FROM capa_verification_evidence WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id
      AND input_snapshot->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
  ) u;
  IF uses<>1 OR matched<>1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Consumed followup proof must commit exactly one matching target atom'; END IF;
  -- The upgrade rejects legacy consumed three-op proofs. Thereafter every
  -- consumption must have one retained target, and every target must have one
  -- consumed proof. Reusing an old proof creates a second target and is rejected.
  -- Trigger events participate in SAVEPOINT rollback without top-xid guessing.
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_quality_followup_atom()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE prior quality_issue_versions%ROWTYPE; c confirmations%ROWTYPE; r action_receipts%ROWTYPE;
  normalized jsonb; old_action jsonb; new_action jsonb; supplied jsonb; observation jsonb; assessment jsonb;
  submitted integer; actual_changed integer := 0; final_status text; basis jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.operation NOT IN ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete') THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO prior FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
    AND id=NEW.previous_issue_version_id;
  IF prior.id IS NULL OR NEW.previous_revision IS DISTINCT FROM prior.revision
    OR NEW.revision IS DISTINCT FROM prior.revision+1 OR prior.status<>'actioning'
    OR ROW(prior.product_id,prior.project_id,prior.issue_id,prior.owner_id,prior.visibility,prior.purpose)
      IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.product_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.issue_id,NEW.owner_id,NEW.visibility,NEW.purpose)
    OR NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(NEW.required_source_read_set)='array'
      AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.required_source_read_set) BETWEEN 1 AND 20
      AND NEW.required_source_read_set @> prior.required_source_read_set
      AND NEW.required_source_read_set @> (NEW.authority_snapshot->'required_source_read_set')
      AND NEW.required_source_read_set @> (NEW.policy_snapshot->'required_source_read_set')
      AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.source_basis->'artifact_sources')='array',false)
    OR NOT COALESCE(NEW.input_snapshot->>'issue_id'=NEW.issue_id::text
      AND (NEW.input_snapshot->>'expected_issue_revision')::integer=prior.revision,false)
    OR NEW.input_snapshot ? 'approval_token' OR NEW.input_snapshot ? 'confirmation_token'
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quality_current_issues WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
      AND product_id=NEW.product_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND issue_id=NEW.issue_id
      AND issue_version_id=NEW.id AND issue_revision=NEW.revision) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup must append the exact current actioning Issue predecessor'; END IF;
  c := assert_quality_followup_proof(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.writer_id,NEW.operation,
    NEW.source_basis->'shared_proof',NEW.created_at);
  r := assert_quality_followup_receipt(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.id,NEW.revision,
    NEW.operation,'quality_issue',NEW.writer_id,NEW.visibility,NEW.status);
  IF NOT COALESCE(NEW.authority_snapshot->>'subject_id'=NEW.writer_id::text
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->>'operation'=NEW.operation
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->>'purpose'=NEW.purpose
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->'scope'->>'tenant_id'=NEW.tenant_id::text
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->'scope'->>'product_id'=NEW.product_id::text
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->'scope'->>'project_id'=NEW.project_id::text
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->'authorized'='true'::jsonb
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->'qualified'='true'::jsonb
    AND (NEW.authority_snapshot->>'valid_until')::timestamptz>NEW.created_at
    AND (NEW.policy_snapshot->>'valid_until')::timestamptz>NEW.created_at,false)
    OR NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(prior.issue_snapshot->'history')='array'
      AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.issue_snapshot->'history')='array'
      AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.issue_snapshot->'history')=jsonb_array_length(prior.issue_snapshot->'history')+1,false)
    OR ((NEW.issue_snapshot->'history') - (jsonb_array_length(NEW.issue_snapshot->'history')-1))
      IS DISTINCT FROM prior.issue_snapshot->'history'
    OR NOT COALESCE(NEW.issue_snapshot->'history'->-1->>'command_id'=r.command_id::text
      AND NEW.issue_snapshot->'history'->-1->>'operation'=NEW.operation
      AND NEW.issue_snapshot->'history'->-1->>'actor_id'=NEW.writer_id::text
      AND NEW.issue_snapshot->'history'->-1->>'actor_kind'='human'
      AND (NEW.issue_snapshot->'history'->-1->>'at')::timestamptz<=NEW.created_at,false)
    OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.source_basis->'artifact_sources') x
      WHERE x->>'visibility'='private') AND NEW.visibility<>'private') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup must retain old history and one exact named command history'; END IF;
  normalized := jsonb_set(NEW.issue_snapshot,
    ARRAY['history',(jsonb_array_length(NEW.issue_snapshot->'history')-1)::text,'at'],'null'::jsonb,false);
  IF NEW.operation='quality.issue.root_cause.decide' THEN
    IF prior.issue_snapshot->'root_cause' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR NEW.status<>'actioning'
      OR (NEW.issue_snapshot-ARRAY['revision','history','root_cause'])
        IS DISTINCT FROM (prior.issue_snapshot-ARRAY['revision','history','root_cause'])
      OR NOT COALESCE(NEW.issue_snapshot->'root_cause'->>'actor_id'=NEW.writer_id::text
        AND NEW.issue_snapshot->'root_cause'->>'text'=NEW.input_snapshot->>'text'
        AND NEW.issue_snapshot->'root_cause'->'sources'=NEW.input_snapshot->'sources'
        AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.issue_snapshot->'root_cause'->'at')='string'
        AND (NEW.issue_snapshot->'root_cause'->>'at')::timestamptz<=NEW.created_at,false) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Root cause adds one named conclusion and never changes earlier CAPA or failures'; END IF;
    normalized := jsonb_set(normalized,ARRAY['root_cause','at'],'null'::jsonb,false);
  ELSE
    IF jsonb_typeof(prior.issue_snapshot->'capa') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR (NEW.issue_snapshot-ARRAY['revision','history','capa','status'])
        IS DISTINCT FROM (prior.issue_snapshot-ARRAY['revision','history','capa','status'])
      OR ((NEW.issue_snapshot->'capa')-'actions') IS DISTINCT FROM ((prior.issue_snapshot->'capa')-'actions')
      OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.input_snapshot->'completions') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
      OR COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(NEW.input_snapshot->'completions'),0) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
      OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
      OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions')
        IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(prior.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completion only appends actual completions to the original CAPA actions'; END IF;
    submitted := jsonb_array_length(NEW.input_snapshot->'completions');
    IF (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.input_snapshot->'completions') x)<>submitted
      OR NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(NEW.source_basis->'completion_observations')='array'
        AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.source_basis->'completion_observations')=submitted
        AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.source_basis->'completion_assessments')='array'
        AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.source_basis->'completion_assessments')=submitted,false)
      OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->'fact'->>'action_id')
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.source_basis->'completion_observations') x)<>submitted
      OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'action_id')
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.source_basis->'completion_assessments') x)<>submitted THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Every completion must have one unique actual fact and host assessment'; END IF;
    FOR old_action,new_action IN SELECT o.value,n.value FROM
      jsonb_array_elements(prior.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions') WITH ORDINALITY o(value,ord)
      JOIN jsonb_array_elements(NEW.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions') WITH ORDINALITY n(value,ord) USING (ord)
    LOOP
      IF (old_action-'completion') IS DISTINCT FROM (new_action-'completion') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completion cannot change action identity, executor, text or ordering'; END IF;
      SELECT x INTO supplied FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.input_snapshot->'completions') x
        WHERE x->>'id'=old_action->>'id';
      IF supplied IS NULL THEN
        IF old_action->'completion' IS DISTINCT FROM new_action->'completion' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unselected original action completion cannot change'; END IF;
      ELSE
        actual_changed := actual_changed+1;
        IF old_action->'completion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
          OR new_action->'completion' IS DISTINCT FROM supplied
          OR supplied->>'executor_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.writer_id::text
          OR old_action->>'executor_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.writer_id::text
          OR NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(supplied->'evidence')='array'
            AND jsonb_array_length(supplied->'evidence') BETWEEN 1 AND 20
            AND (supplied->'evidence') @> jsonb_build_array(supplied->'at'->'source'),false)
          OR (supplied->'at'->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz>NEW.created_at THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completion requires original executor, exact event evidence and an already observed clock'; END IF;
        SELECT x INTO observation FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.source_basis->'completion_observations') x
          WHERE x->'fact'->>'action_id'=old_action->>'id';
        IF NOT COALESCE(observation->'fact'->>'issue_id'=NEW.issue_id::text
          AND observation->'fact'->>'capa_id'=NEW.issue_snapshot->'capa'->>'id'
          AND observation->'fact'->>'executor_id'=NEW.writer_id::text
          AND observation->'fact'->>'operation'=NEW.operation
          AND observation->'fact'->>'purpose'=NEW.purpose
          AND observation->'fact'->>'text'=supplied->>'text'
          AND observation->'fact'->>'original_timezone'=supplied->'at'->>'original_timezone'
          AND (observation->'fact'->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz=(supplied->'at'->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz
          AND jsonb_typeof(observation->'received_at')='string'
          AND (observation->>'received_at')::timestamptz<=NEW.created_at
          AND (observation->>'received_at')::timestamptz>=(supplied->'at'->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz,false) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Saved completion must bind the exact separately received structured fact'; END IF;
        SELECT x INTO assessment FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.source_basis->'completion_assessments') x
          WHERE x->>'action_id'=old_action->>'id';
        IF NOT COALESCE(assessment->>'issue_id'=NEW.issue_id::text
          AND assessment->>'capa_id'=NEW.issue_snapshot->'capa'->>'id'
          AND assessment->>'executor_id'=NEW.writer_id::text
          AND assessment->>'purpose'=NEW.purpose
          AND assessment->'scope'->>'tenant_id'=NEW.tenant_id::text
          AND assessment->'scope'->>'product_id'=NEW.product_id::text
          AND assessment->'scope'->>'project_id'=NEW.project_id::text
          AND assessment->>'basis_sha256'=NEW.source_basis->'followup_basis'->>'basis_sha256'
          AND assessment->>'nature'=NEW.source_basis->'followup_basis'->>'nature'
          AND assessment->'event_source'=supplied->'at'->'source'
          AND assessment->'allowed'='true'::jsonb AND assessment->'current'='true'::jsonb
          AND assessment->>'classification' IN ('investigation','formal_change')
          AND (assessment->>'valid_until')::timestamptz>NEW.created_at
          AND NEW.required_source_read_set @> (assessment->'required_source_read_set')
          AND (assessment->>'classification'<>'formal_change'
            OR (jsonb_typeof(assessment->'owner_proofs')='array'
              AND jsonb_array_length(assessment->'owner_proofs')>0)),false) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completion must retain its exact positive host binding and formal owner proof shape'; END IF;
      END IF;
    END LOOP;
    IF actual_changed<>submitted THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Every submitted completion must belong to an original action'; END IF;
    final_status := CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions') x
      WHERE x->'completion'='null'::jsonb) THEN 'actioning' ELSE 'awaiting_verification' END;
    IF NEW.status<>final_status THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Complete CAPA changes to awaiting verification only, never effectiveness or closed'; END IF;
    IF c.snapshot->'completion_assessments' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_basis->'completion_assessments'
      OR c.snapshot->'completion_observations' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'fact' ORDER BY ord)
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.source_basis->'completion_observations') WITH ORDINALITY v(x,ord)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completion actual facts and host assessments must match the consumed review'; END IF;
  END IF;
  basis := NEW.source_basis-'shared_proof'-'completion_observations';
  IF c.snapshot->'before'->(NEW.issue_id::text) IS DISTINCT FROM prior.issue_snapshot
    OR c.snapshot->'after'->(NEW.issue_id::text) IS DISTINCT FROM normalized
    OR c.snapshot->'read_basis'->'authority' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.authority_snapshot
    OR c.snapshot->'read_basis'->'policy' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.policy_snapshot
    OR c.snapshot->'read_basis'->'source_basis' IS DISTINCT FROM basis
    OR c.snapshot->'read_basis'->'read_set' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.required_source_read_set
    OR c.snapshot->>'event_effect' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE NEW.operation
      WHEN 'quality.issue.root_cause.decide' THEN 'issue.root_cause_decided' ELSE 'capa.actions_completed' END)
    OR c.snapshot->>'clock_basis' IS DISTINCT FROM 'server_on_save' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Issue successor, exact evidence and consumed material review must match'; END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_capa_link_atom()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE parent quality_issue_versions%ROWTYPE; c confirmations%ROWTYPE; r action_receipts%ROWTYPE;
  action jsonb; binding jsonb; refs jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO parent FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
    AND product_id=NEW.product_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND issue_id=NEW.issue_id
    AND id=NEW.issue_version_id AND revision=NEW.issue_revision;
  IF parent.id IS NULL OR NEW.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.writer_id
    OR parent.purpose IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.purpose
    OR parent.issue_snapshot->'capa'->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.capa_id::text
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quality_current_issues WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
      AND product_id=NEW.product_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND issue_id=NEW.issue_id
      AND issue_version_id=NEW.issue_version_id AND issue_revision=NEW.issue_revision)
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(parent.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions') x
      WHERE x->>'id'=NEW.action_id::text)<>1
    OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.basis_snapshot->'actions') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.basis_snapshot->'actions') x
      WHERE x->>'action_id'=NEW.action_id::text)<>1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA link requires the exact current Issue, CAPA and original action'; END IF;
  SELECT x INTO action FROM jsonb_array_elements(parent.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions') x
    WHERE x->>'id'=NEW.action_id::text;
  SELECT x INTO binding FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.basis_snapshot->'actions') x
    WHERE x->>'action_id'=NEW.action_id::text;
  IF binding->>'executor_id' IS DISTINCT FROM action->>'executor_id'
    OR NEW.basis_snapshot->>'owner_id' IS DISTINCT FROM parent.owner_id::text
    OR NEW.basis_snapshot->>'visibility' IS DISTINCT FROM parent.visibility
    OR NEW.basis_snapshot->'requirement' IS DISTINCT FROM parent.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'requirement'
    OR NEW.basis_snapshot->>'basis_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.basis_sha256
    OR NEW.output_snapshot->'basis' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.basis_snapshot
    OR NEW.output_snapshot->'action_fulfilled' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
    OR NEW.output_snapshot->>'owner_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.owner_id::text
    OR (NEW.output_snapshot->>'visibility'='private' AND NEW.visibility<>'private')
    OR NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(NEW.output_snapshot->'outputs')='array'
      AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.output_snapshot->'outputs') BETWEEN 1 AND 20,false)
    OR NOT COALESCE(NEW.input_snapshot->>'issue_id'=NEW.issue_id::text
      AND (NEW.input_snapshot->>'expected_issue_revision')::integer=NEW.issue_revision
      AND NEW.input_snapshot->>'capa_id'=NEW.capa_id::text
      AND NEW.input_snapshot->>'action_id'=NEW.action_id::text
      AND NEW.input_snapshot->>'reason'=NEW.reason
      AND NEW.required_source_read_set @> parent.required_source_read_set
      AND NEW.required_source_read_set @> (NEW.basis_snapshot->'required_source_read_set')
      AND NEW.required_source_read_set @> (NEW.output_snapshot->'required_source_read_set')
      AND NEW.required_source_read_set @> (NEW.authority_snapshot->'required_source_read_set')
      AND NEW.required_source_read_set @> (NEW.policy_snapshot->'required_source_read_set')
      AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.source_basis->'artifact_sources')='array',false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA link must retain exact basis, action and unknown fulfillment'; END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'ref' ORDER BY ord) INTO refs
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.output_snapshot->'outputs') WITH ORDINALITY v(x,ord);
  IF refs IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.input_snapshot->'output_refs'
    OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->'ref') FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.output_snapshot->'outputs') x)
      <>jsonb_array_length(NEW.output_snapshot->'outputs')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.output_snapshot->'outputs') x WHERE NOT COALESCE(
      x->'ref'->>'kind' IN ('definition','bom','engineering_configuration','manufacturing_configuration',
        'build','actual_configuration','build_lot','sample','verification_preparation',
        'verification_request','verification_run')
      AND x->'ref'->>'id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      AND (x->'ref'->>'revision')::integer>0
      AND x->>'meaning' IN ('draft','planned','observed','performed')
      AND x->>'visibility' IN ('private','product')
      AND (x->'ref'->'key'='null'::jsonb OR x->'ref'->>'kind' IN ('bom','manufacturing_configuration')),false))
    OR ((parent.visibility='private' OR NEW.policy_snapshot->'private'='true'::jsonb
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.source_basis->'artifact_sources') x
        WHERE x->>'visibility'='private')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.output_snapshot->'outputs') x
        WHERE x->>'visibility'='private')) AND NEW.visibility<>'private') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA output references must be exact, ordered, unique and preserve private scope'; END IF;
  c := assert_quality_followup_proof(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.writer_id,
    'quality.capa.followup.link',NEW.input_snapshot->'shared_proof',NEW.created_at);
  r := assert_quality_followup_receipt(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.id,NEW.revision,
    'quality.capa.followup.link','capa_remediation_link',NEW.writer_id,NEW.visibility,NEW.status);
  IF NOT COALESCE(NEW.authority_snapshot->>'subject_id'=NEW.writer_id::text
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->>'operation'='quality.capa.followup.link'
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->>'purpose'=NEW.purpose
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->'scope'->>'tenant_id'=NEW.tenant_id::text
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->'scope'->>'product_id'=NEW.product_id::text
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->'scope'->>'project_id'=NEW.project_id::text
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->'authorized'='true'::jsonb
    AND NEW.authority_snapshot->'qualified'='true'::jsonb
    AND (NEW.authority_snapshot->>'valid_until')::timestamptz>NEW.created_at
    AND (NEW.policy_snapshot->>'valid_until')::timestamptz>NEW.created_at,false)
    OR c.snapshot->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'quality.capa.followup.link'
    OR c.snapshot->'before' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
    OR c.snapshot->'after'->'id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
    OR c.snapshot->'after'->'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb
    OR c.snapshot->'after'->>'issue_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.issue_id::text
    OR (c.snapshot->'after'->>'issue_revision')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.issue_revision
    OR c.snapshot->'after'->>'capa_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.capa_id::text
    OR c.snapshot->'after'->>'action_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.action_id::text
    OR c.snapshot->'after'->'resolution' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.output_snapshot
    OR c.snapshot->'after'->>'visibility' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.visibility
    OR c.snapshot->'after'->>'received_at' IS DISTINCT FROM 'server_on_save'
    OR c.snapshot->'after'->'action_fulfilled' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
    OR c.snapshot->'authority' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.authority_snapshot
    OR c.snapshot->'policy' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.policy_snapshot
    OR c.snapshot->'required_source_read_set' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.required_source_read_set
    OR c.snapshot->>'reason' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.reason THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA link and consumed material review must match'; END IF;
  -- Output owner rows, current source bytes/issuer epochs, action and basis
  -- canonical SHA256s are verified by host owner ports, not JSONB text hashes.
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_capa_fact_source_closure(tid uuid, pid uuid, sources jsonb, reads jsonb, basis jsonb, audience text, owner uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE x jsonb; b jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(sources)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(sources)>0
    AND jsonb_typeof(reads)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(reads) BETWEEN 1 AND 20
    AND jsonb_typeof(basis)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(basis)=jsonb_array_length(reads),false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA fact requires complete bounded source arrays'; END IF;
  IF (SELECT count(DISTINCT read_element.value->>'artifact_id')
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(reads) AS read_element(value))
       <>jsonb_array_length(reads)
    OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT basis_element.value->>'id')
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(basis) AS basis_element(value))
       <>jsonb_array_length(basis) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA source identities cannot be duplicate or truncated'; END IF;
  FOR x IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(reads) LOOP
    IF NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(x)='object'
      AND (x-ARRAY['artifact_id','expected_revision'])='{}'::jsonb
      AND x->>'artifact_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      AND jsonb_typeof(x->'expected_revision')='number'
      AND (x->>'expected_revision')::integer>0,false) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA source read requires exact Artifact revision'; END IF;
    SELECT value INTO b FROM jsonb_array_elements(basis)
      WHERE value->>'id'=x->>'artifact_id';
    IF NOT COALESCE(b->'revision'=x->'expected_revision' AND b->>'status'='active'
      AND b->>'hash' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND b->>'visibility' IN ('private','product')
      AND b->>'owner_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$',false)
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM artifact_versions a WHERE a.tenant_id=tid AND a.product_id=pid
        AND a.id=(x->>'artifact_id')::uuid AND a.revision=(x->>'expected_revision')::integer
        AND a.content_hash=b->>'hash' AND a.status='active'
        AND a.visibility=b->>'visibility' AND a.owner_id=(b->>'owner_id')::uuid)
      OR (b->>'visibility'='private' AND (audience<>'private' OR b->>'owner_id'<>owner::text)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA exact source identity or audience differs'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  FOR x IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(sources) LOOP
    IF x->>'kind'='artifact' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(reads) r
      WHERE r->>'artifact_id'=x->>'id' AND r->'expected_revision'=x->'revision') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Every Artifact source must remain in the complete read set'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  -- Raw native/uploaded provenance remains unchanged. Bytes, security epoch,
  -- issuer and professional qualification still require real host gates.
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_capa_fact_origin(tid uuid, pid uuid, project uuid, issue uuid, capa uuid, origin_id uuid, origin_rev integer, purpose_value text, nature_value text, anchor jsonb, reads jsonb, audience text, actor uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE original quality_issue_versions%ROWTYPE; p projects%ROWTYPE; raw jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO original FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid AND product_id=pid
    AND project_id=project AND issue_id=issue AND id=origin_id AND revision=origin_rev;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM projects WHERE tenant_id=tid AND product_id=pid AND id=project;
  raw := anchor->'origin';
  IF original.id IS NULL OR p.id IS NULL OR p.status<>'active'
    OR (p.visibility='private' AND p.owner_id<>actor)
    OR original.operation<>'quality.capa.actions.complete' OR original.status<>'awaiting_verification'
    OR NOT COALESCE(original.issue_snapshot->'capa'->>'id'=capa::text
      AND jsonb_typeof(original.issue_snapshot->'root_cause')='object'
      AND jsonb_typeof(original.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions')='array'
      AND jsonb_array_length(original.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions')>0
      AND NOT (original.issue_snapshot->>'needs_recheck')::boolean
      AND original.issue_snapshot->'merged_into'='null'::jsonb
      AND original.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'effectiveness'='null'::jsonb
      AND original.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'effectiveness_history'='[]'::jsonb
      AND original.issue_snapshot->'recheck_reasons'='[]'::jsonb
      AND original.issue_snapshot->'closure'='null'::jsonb
      AND raw->'ref'->>'id'=origin_id::text AND (raw->'ref'->>'revision')::integer=origin_rev
      AND raw->'ref'->>'snapshot_sha256'=original.snapshot_sha256
      AND raw->'scope'->>'tenant_id'=tid::text AND raw->'scope'->>'product_id'=pid::text
      AND raw->'scope'->>'project_id'=project::text AND raw->>'issue_id'=issue::text
      AND raw->>'purpose'=purpose_value AND raw->>'purpose'=original.purpose
      AND raw->>'nature'=nature_value
      AND raw->>'owner_id'=original.owner_id::text AND raw->>'visibility'=original.visibility
      AND raw->>'writer_id'=original.writer_id::text
      AND raw->>'operation'=original.operation
      AND (raw->>'created_at')::timestamptz=original.created_at
      AND raw->'issue'=original.issue_snapshot AND raw->'input_snapshot'=original.input_snapshot
      AND raw->'authority_snapshot'=original.authority_snapshot
      AND raw->'policy_snapshot'=original.policy_snapshot
      AND raw->'persisted_source_basis'=original.source_basis
      AND reads @> original.required_source_read_set
      AND jsonb_typeof(anchor->'origin_required_source_read_set')='array'
      AND reads @> (anchor->'origin_required_source_read_set'),false)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(original.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions') x
      WHERE jsonb_typeof(x->'completion') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object')
    OR (original.visibility='private' AND (audience<>'private' OR original.owner_id<>actor)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA publication requires exact immutable completed origin and preserves private scope'; END IF;
  -- No comparison deletes Current descendant history. Legal later lineage and
  -- all original failure bytes must be attested by the missing actual owners.
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_capa_fact_current()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE target jsonb; allowed text[] := ARRAY['fact_id','fact_revision','epoch'];
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA fact Current cannot be deleted'; END IF;
  PERFORM 1 FROM products WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.product_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA Current product gate missing'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='capa_current_verification_rules' THEN
    SELECT to_jsonb(f) INTO target FROM capa_verification_rule_facts f
      WHERE f.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND f.id=NEW.fact_id;
    allowed := allowed || ARRAY['issuer_version'];
    IF target->>'issuer_key' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.issuer_key
      OR target->>'issuer_version' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.issuer_version
      OR target->>'external_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.external_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Rule Current requires exact issuer series and version'; END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='capa_current_observations' THEN
    SELECT to_jsonb(f) INTO target FROM capa_observation_facts f
      WHERE f.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND f.id=NEW.fact_id;
  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unsupported CAPA Current target'; END IF;
  IF target IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(
    target->>'product_id'=NEW.product_id::text AND target->>'project_id'=NEW.project_id::text
    AND target->>'issue_id'=NEW.issue_id::text AND target->>'capa_id'=NEW.capa_id::text
    AND target->>'series_id'=NEW.series_id::text AND (target->>'revision')::integer=NEW.fact_revision
    AND target->>'origin_issue_version_id'=NEW.origin_issue_version_id::text
    AND (target->>'origin_issue_revision')::integer=NEW.origin_issue_revision
    AND target->>'owner_id'=NEW.owner_id::text AND target->>'visibility'=NEW.visibility
    AND target->>'nature'=NEW.nature AND target->>'purpose'=NEW.purpose
    AND target->>'anchor_sha256'=NEW.anchor_sha256 AND target->>'requirement_sha256'=NEW.requirement_sha256
    AND target->'anchor_snapshot'=NEW.anchor_snapshot,false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA Current requires exact full scoped immutable target'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.fact_revision<>1 OR NEW.epoch<>1 OR NEW.series_id<>NEW.fact_id
      OR target->'previous_fact_id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR target->'previous_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA Current begins at exact first version and epoch one'; END IF;
  ELSE
    IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-allowed) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-allowed)
      OR NEW.fact_id=OLD.fact_id OR NEW.fact_revision<>OLD.fact_revision+1 OR NEW.epoch<>OLD.epoch+1
      OR target->>'previous_fact_id' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.fact_id::text
      OR (target->>'previous_revision')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.fact_revision THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA Current requires exact continuous predecessor and monotonic epoch'; END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_capa_publication_receipt_atom()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE target_table text; uses integer;
BEGIN
  target_table := CASE NEW.operation
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.rule.import' THEN 'capa_verification_rule_facts'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.observation.record' THEN 'capa_observation_facts'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.review' THEN 'capa_named_verification_reviews'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.candidate.record' THEN 'capa_verification_evidence' END;
  IF target_table IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO uses FROM (
    SELECT id FROM capa_verification_rule_facts WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.subject_id
      AND revision=NEW.subject_revision AND target_table='capa_verification_rule_facts'
    UNION ALL SELECT id FROM capa_observation_facts WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.subject_id
      AND revision=NEW.subject_revision AND target_table='capa_observation_facts'
    UNION ALL SELECT id FROM capa_named_verification_reviews WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.subject_id
      AND revision=NEW.subject_revision AND target_table='capa_named_verification_reviews'
    UNION ALL SELECT id FROM capa_verification_evidence WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.subject_id
      AND revision=NEW.subject_revision AND target_table='capa_verification_evidence'
  ) u;
  IF uses<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA publication receipt requires exactly one actual target'; END IF;
  PERFORM assert_capa_publication_atom(target_table,NEW.tenant_id,NEW.subject_id);
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$
