CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_change_order_atom()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  atom jsonb := to_jsonb(NEW);
  parent change_request_versions%ROWTYPE;
  previous change_request_versions%ROWTYPE;
  proof confirmations%ROWTYPE;
  receipt action_receipts%ROWTYPE;
  effect text;
  order_body jsonb;
  proposed jsonb;
  expected_tier text;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT parent FROM change_request_versions
    WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND product_id=NEW.product_id
      AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND change_id=NEW.change_id
      AND id=NEW.change_version_id AND revision=NEW.change_revision;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT previous FROM change_request_versions
    WHERE tenant_id=parent.tenant_id AND product_id=parent.product_id
      AND project_id=parent.project_id AND change_id=parent.change_id
      AND id=parent.previous_version_id AND revision=parent.previous_revision;
  IF parent.operation IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.operation
    OR parent.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM previous.owner_id
    OR parent.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM previous.visibility
    OR parent.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.owner_id
    OR parent.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.visibility
    OR parent.sources IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.sources
    OR parent.required_source_read_set IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.required_source_read_set
    OR parent.source_basis IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_basis
    OR parent.authority_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.authority_snapshot
    OR (parent.request_snapshot->>'id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM parent.change_id
    OR (parent.request_snapshot->'scope'->>'tenant_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM parent.tenant_id
    OR (parent.request_snapshot->'scope'->>'product_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM parent.product_id
    OR (parent.request_snapshot->'scope'->>'project_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM parent.project_id
    OR (parent.request_snapshot - ARRAY['revision','status','history','orders']) IS DISTINCT FROM (previous.request_snapshot - ARRAY['revision','status','history','orders'])
    OR jsonb_array_length(parent.request_snapshot->'history') <> jsonb_array_length(previous.request_snapshot->'history')+1
    OR ((parent.request_snapshot->'history') - (jsonb_array_length(parent.request_snapshot->'history')-1)) IS DISTINCT FROM (previous.request_snapshot->'history')
    OR (parent.request_snapshot->'history'->-1->>'command_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.command_id
    OR (parent.request_snapshot->'history'->-1->>'actor_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.actor_id
    OR (parent.request_snapshot->'history'->-1->>'operation') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.operation
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'change atom parent mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  expected_tier := CASE NEW.operation WHEN 'change.order.approve' THEN 'T2' ELSE 'T1' END;
  IF NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(NEW.input_snapshot)='object'
    AND NEW.input_snapshot ?& ARRAY['semantic','shared_proof','review']
    AND (NEW.input_snapshot - ARRAY['semantic','shared_proof','review'])='{}'::jsonb
    AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.input_snapshot->'review')='object'
    AND (NEW.input_snapshot->'review') ?& ARRAY['operation','payload_semantic','before','after','read_set','sources','authority','policy','source_basis','selection','effect','unknown','proof_tier']
    AND ((NEW.input_snapshot->'review') - ARRAY['operation','payload_semantic','before','after','read_set','sources','authority','policy','source_basis','selection','effect','unknown','proof_tier'])='{}'::jsonb
    AND (NEW.input_snapshot->'shared_proof')=jsonb_build_object('id',NEW.shared_proof_id,'tier',expected_tier)
    AND jsonb_typeof(parent.request_snapshot->'history')='array'
    AND jsonb_typeof(parent.request_snapshot->'orders')='array',false)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact change review shape required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  proposed := jsonb_set(parent.request_snapshot,'{history,-1,at}','"server_on_save"'::jsonb);
  IF NEW.operation='change.order.approve' THEN
    proposed := jsonb_set(proposed,'{orders,-1,approvals,-1,at}','"server_on_save"'::jsonb);
    proposed := jsonb_set(proposed,'{orders,-1,approvals,-1,decision_id}','"actual_consumed_named_proof_on_save"'::jsonb);
  END IF;
  IF NEW.input_snapshot->'review'->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.operation
    OR NEW.input_snapshot->'review'->>'proof_tier' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_tier
    OR NEW.input_snapshot->'review'->'payload_semantic' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.input_snapshot->'semantic'
    OR NEW.input_snapshot->'review'->'before' IS DISTINCT FROM previous.request_snapshot
    OR NEW.input_snapshot->'review'->'after' IS DISTINCT FROM proposed
    OR NEW.input_snapshot->'review'->'read_set' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.required_source_read_set
    OR NEW.input_snapshot->'review'->'sources' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.sources
    OR NEW.input_snapshot->'review'->'authority' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.authority_snapshot
    OR NEW.input_snapshot->'review'->'policy' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.policy_snapshot
    OR NEW.input_snapshot->'review'->'source_basis' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_basis
    OR NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(NEW.sources)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.sources) BETWEEN 1 AND 20
      AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.required_source_read_set)='array'
      AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.required_source_read_set) BETWEEN 1 AND 20,false)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'change review correspondence mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT proof FROM confirmations
    WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND product_id=NEW.product_id AND id=NEW.shared_proof_id;
  IF NOT proof.consumed OR proof.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.actor_id
    OR proof.subject_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.product_id
    OR proof.operation IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.operation
    OR proof.revision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.shared_proof_revision
    OR proof.token_hash IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.token_sha256
    OR proof.payload_digest IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.material_sha256
    OR proof.snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.input_snapshot->'review')
    OR proof.created_at > NEW.proof_consumed_at
    OR NEW.proof_consumed_at > NEW.created_at OR NEW.created_at >= proof.expires_at
    OR proof.expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.proof_expires_at
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'change proof group mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT receipt FROM action_receipts
    WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND product_id=NEW.product_id
      AND operation=NEW.operation AND subject_type='change_request'
      AND subject_id=parent.id AND subject_revision=parent.revision;
  effect := CASE NEW.operation WHEN 'change.order.prepare' THEN 'change.order_prepared'
    WHEN 'change.order.approve' THEN 'change.approved' ELSE 'change.implementation_recorded' END;
  IF receipt.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.actor_id
    OR receipt.requester_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.actor_id OR receipt.run_id IS NOT NULL
    OR receipt.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM parent.visibility
    OR receipt.command_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.command_id
    OR receipt.intent_digest IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.intent_digest
    OR (receipt.result->>'id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM parent.id
    OR (receipt.result->>'revision')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM parent.revision
    OR receipt.result->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM parent.status
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM request_keys k WHERE k.tenant_id=receipt.tenant_id
      AND k.actor_id=receipt.actor_id AND k.receipt_id=receipt.id AND k.digest=receipt.request_digest)
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_entries a WHERE a.tenant_id=receipt.tenant_id AND a.receipt_id=receipt.id
      AND a.actor_id=receipt.actor_id AND a.operation=receipt.operation)<>1
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_events o WHERE o.tenant_id=receipt.tenant_id AND o.receipt_id=receipt.id
      AND o.type=effect AND o.actor_id=receipt.actor_id AND o.correlation_id=receipt.command_id
      AND o.subject_id=parent.id AND o.subject_revision=parent.revision)<>1
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'change common group mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  order_body := parent.request_snapshot->'orders'->-1;
  IF NEW.operation<>'change.order.prepare' AND (
    jsonb_array_length(parent.request_snapshot->'orders') IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(previous.request_snapshot->'orders')
    OR ((parent.request_snapshot->'orders') - (jsonb_array_length(parent.request_snapshot->'orders')-1)) IS DISTINCT FROM
       ((previous.request_snapshot->'orders') - (jsonb_array_length(previous.request_snapshot->'orders')-1)))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'earlier Orders must remain exact'; END IF;
  IF NEW.operation='change.order.prepare' THEN
    IF ((parent.request_snapshot->'orders') - (jsonb_array_length(parent.request_snapshot->'orders')-1)) IS DISTINCT FROM (previous.request_snapshot->'orders')
      OR parent.status <> 'review' OR previous.status NOT IN ('analysis','review')
      OR jsonb_array_length(order_body->'approvals')<>0
      OR jsonb_array_length(order_body->'implementations')<>0
      OR order_body IS DISTINCT FROM (atom->'order_snapshot')
      OR (order_body->>'id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM (atom->>'order_id')::uuid
      OR order_body->>'content_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM atom->>'content_sha256'
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'order material mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.operation='change.order.approve' THEN
    IF ((order_body->'approvals') - (jsonb_array_length(order_body->'approvals')-1)) IS DISTINCT FROM (previous.request_snapshot->'orders'->-1->'approvals')
      OR (order_body - 'approvals') IS DISTINCT FROM ((previous.request_snapshot->'orders'->-1) - 'approvals')
      OR previous.status <> 'review' OR parent.status NOT IN ('review','approved')
      OR (previous.request_snapshot->>'requester_id')::uuid = NEW.actor_id
      OR (order_body->'approvals'->-1) IS DISTINCT FROM (atom->'approval_snapshot')
      OR (atom->'approval_snapshot'->>'decision_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.shared_proof_id
      OR (atom->'approval_snapshot'->>'discipline') IS DISTINCT FROM (atom->>'discipline')
      OR (atom->'approval_snapshot'->>'actor_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.actor_id
      OR (atom->'approval_snapshot'->>'content_digest') IS DISTINCT FROM order_body->>'content_digest'
      OR NOT COALESCE(order_body->'required_disciplines' @> jsonb_build_array(atom->>'discipline'),false)
      OR (atom->'approval_snapshot'->>'at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (parent.request_snapshot->'history'->-1->>'at')::timestamptz
      OR (order_body->'implementations') IS DISTINCT FROM (previous.request_snapshot->'orders'->-1->'implementations')
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'approval material mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
    IF ((order_body->'implementations') - (jsonb_array_length(order_body->'implementations')-1)) IS DISTINCT FROM (previous.request_snapshot->'orders'->-1->'implementations')
      OR (order_body - 'implementations') IS DISTINCT FROM ((previous.request_snapshot->'orders'->-1) - 'implementations')
      OR previous.status NOT IN ('approved','implementing') OR parent.status <> 'implementing'
      OR (order_body->'implementations'->-1) IS DISTINCT FROM (atom->'fact_snapshot')
      OR (atom->'fact_snapshot'->>'executor_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.actor_id
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM change_implementation_captures c WHERE c.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
        AND c.product_id=NEW.product_id AND c.project_id=NEW.project_id AND c.change_id=NEW.change_id
        AND c.id=(atom->>'capture_id')::uuid AND c.fact_id=(atom->>'fact_id')::uuid
        AND c.fact_snapshot=(atom->'fact_snapshot') AND c.output_basis=(atom->'output_basis'))
      OR NOT (order_body->'required_disciplines' @> '["engineering","manufacturing"]'::jsonb)
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'implementation material mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_change_implementation_capture()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE parent change_request_versions%ROWTYPE; o jsonb; item jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT parent FROM change_request_versions
    WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND product_id=NEW.product_id
      AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND change_id=NEW.change_id
      AND id=NEW.change_version_id AND revision=NEW.change_revision;
  SELECT v INTO STRICT o FROM jsonb_array_elements(parent.request_snapshot->'orders') v
    WHERE (v->>'id')::uuid=NEW.order_id;
  SELECT v INTO STRICT item FROM jsonb_array_elements(o->'plan'->'items') v
    WHERE (v->>'id')::uuid=NEW.item_id;
  IF parent.status NOT IN ('approved','implementing')
    OR ROW(parent.owner_id,parent.visibility) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.owner_id,NEW.visibility)
    OR NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(NEW.occurrence_snapshot)='object'
      AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.fact_snapshot)='object'
      AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.sources)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.sources) BETWEEN 1 AND 20
      AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.required_source_read_set)='array'
      AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.required_source_read_set) BETWEEN 1 AND 20,false)
    OR NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pdos-change-implementation-occurrence-v2'
    OR NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
      'tenant_id',NEW.tenant_id,'product_id',NEW.product_id,'project_id',NEW.project_id)
    OR (NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'change_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.change_id
    OR (NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'order_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.order_id
    OR (NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'item_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.item_id
    OR (NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'implementation_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.fact_id
    OR (NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'executor_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.executor_id
    OR NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'change.implementation.record'
    OR (NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'intent_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM (item->'intent'->>'id')::uuid
    OR NEW.fact_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
      'id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'implementation_id',
      'reconciles_id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'reconciles_id',
      'item_id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'item_id','intent_id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'intent_id',
      'executor_id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'executor_id','outcome',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'outcome',
      'occurred_at',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'occurred_at','received_at',NEW.fact_snapshot->'received_at',
      'sources',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'sources','outputs',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'outputs',
      'note',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'note','nature',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'nature')
    OR (NEW.fact_snapshot->>'received_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.created_at
    OR NOT COALESCE((NEW.fact_snapshot->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz<=NEW.created_at
      AND NEW.created_at<=clock_timestamp()
      AND NEW.expires_at<=(o->'plan'->>'expires_at')::timestamptz,false)
    OR NOT COALESCE(NEW.sources @> (NEW.fact_snapshot->'sources'),false)
    OR NOT COALESCE(o->'required_disciplines' @> '["engineering","manufacturing"]'::jsonb,false)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(o->'required_disciplines') d
      WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(o->'approvals') a
        WHERE a->'discipline'=d AND (a->>'actor_id')::uuid<>(parent.request_snapshot->>'requester_id')::uuid
          AND a->>'content_digest'=o->>'content_digest'
          AND (a->>'at')::timestamptz<=(NEW.fact_snapshot->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz
          AND (NEW.fact_snapshot->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz<(a->>'expires_at')::timestamptz
          AND NEW.expires_at<=(a->>'expires_at')::timestamptz))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'prepared implementation capture mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_controlled_change_atom(tab text, tid uuid, target uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE a jsonb; r action_receipts%ROWTYPE; p confirmations%ROWTYPE;
  family text; effect text; parent change_request_versions%ROWTYPE;
  issue quality_issue_versions%ROWTYPE; policy controlled_change_policy_facts%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF tab NOT IN ('controlled_change_policy_facts','controlled_change_selection_facts') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown controlled atom'; END IF;
  EXECUTE format('SELECT to_jsonb(t) FROM public.%I t WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2',tab)
    INTO STRICT a USING tid,target;
  IF tab='controlled_change_policy_facts' THEN
    family:='change_policy_fact'; effect:='change.policy_imported';
    IF NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(a->'material')='object' AND (a->'material') ?&
      ARRAY['schema_version','scope','purpose','owner_id','visibility','publisher_id','required_disciplines','valid_from','valid_until','nature']
      AND ((a->'material') - ARRAY['schema_version','scope','purpose','owner_id','visibility','publisher_id','required_disciplines','valid_from','valid_until','nature'])='{}'::jsonb
      AND jsonb_typeof(a->'material'->'required_disciplines')='array'
      AND jsonb_array_length(a->'material'->'required_disciplines') BETWEEN 2 AND 4,false)
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact policy JSON shape required'; END IF;
    IF a->>'operation'<>'change.policy.import' OR a->>'status'<>'published'
      OR a->'material'->>'schema_version'<>'pdos-controlled-change-policy-v1'
      OR (a->'material'->>'publisher_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'actor_id')::uuid
      OR (a->'material'->>'owner_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'owner_id')::uuid
      OR a->'material'->>'visibility' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'visibility'
      OR (a->'material'->>'valid_from')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'valid_from')::timestamptz
      OR (a->'material'->>'valid_until')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'valid_until')::timestamptz
      OR NOT (a->'material'->'required_disciplines' @> '["engineering","manufacturing"]'::jsonb)
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM controlled_change_policy_currents c WHERE c.tenant_id=tid
        AND c.product_id=(a->>'product_id')::uuid AND c.project_id=(a->>'project_id')::uuid
        AND c.purpose_sha256=a->>'purpose_sha256' AND c.fact_id=target
        AND c.revision=(a->>'revision')::integer AND c.epoch=(a->>'epoch')::integer)
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled policy material/current mismatch'; END IF;
  ELSE
    family:='change_selection_fact'; effect:='change.selection_decided';
    IF NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(a->'material')='object' AND (a->'material') ?&
      ARRAY['schema_version','scope','purpose','change_id','item','issue_id','capa_id','action_id','action_sha256','executor_id','decider_id','status','valid_until','reason','nature']
      AND ((a->'material') - ARRAY['schema_version','scope','purpose','change_id','item','issue_id','capa_id','action_id','action_sha256','executor_id','decider_id','status','valid_until','reason','nature'])='{}'::jsonb,false)
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact selection JSON shape required'; END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT parent FROM change_request_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid
      AND product_id=(a->>'product_id')::uuid AND project_id=(a->>'project_id')::uuid
      AND change_id=(a->>'change_id')::uuid AND id=(a->>'change_version_id')::uuid
      AND revision=(a->>'change_revision')::integer;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT issue FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid
      AND product_id=parent.product_id AND project_id=parent.project_id
      AND issue_id=(a->>'issue_id')::uuid AND id=(a->>'issue_version_id')::uuid
      AND revision=(a->>'issue_revision')::integer;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT policy FROM controlled_change_policy_facts WHERE tenant_id=tid
      AND product_id=parent.product_id AND project_id=parent.project_id
      AND id=(a->>'policy_id')::uuid AND revision=(a->>'policy_revision')::integer;
    IF a->>'operation'<>'change.selection.decide'
      OR a->'material'->>'schema_version'<>'pdos-controlled-change-selection-v1'
      OR (a->'material'->>'change_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM parent.change_id
      OR (a->'material'->'item'->>'id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'item_id')::uuid
      OR (a->'material'->'item'->'intent'->>'id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'intent_id')::uuid
      OR (a->'material'->>'issue_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM issue.issue_id
      OR (a->'material'->>'capa_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'capa_id')::uuid
      OR (issue.issue_snapshot->'capa'->>'id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'capa_id')::uuid
      OR (a->'material'->>'action_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'action_id')::uuid
      OR a->'material'->>'action_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'action_sha256'
      OR (a->'material'->>'decider_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'actor_id')::uuid
      OR a->'material'->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'status'
      OR (a->'material'->>'valid_until')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'valid_until')::timestamptz
      OR parent.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'owner_id')::uuid
      OR parent.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'visibility'
      OR issue.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM parent.owner_id OR issue.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM parent.visibility
      OR a->'policy_snapshot'->'owner_proof'->'receipt'->>'subject_id' IS DISTINCT FROM policy.id::text
      OR a->'policy_snapshot'->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM policy.material->'scope'
      OR a->'policy_snapshot'->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM policy.purpose
      OR a->'policy_snapshot'->>'owner_id' IS DISTINCT FROM policy.owner_id::text
      OR a->'policy_snapshot'->>'visibility' IS DISTINCT FROM policy.visibility
      OR a->'policy_snapshot'->>'nature' IS DISTINCT FROM policy.nature
      OR a->'policy_snapshot'->'source' IS DISTINCT FROM policy.source
      OR (a->'policy_snapshot'->>'epoch')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM policy.epoch
      OR a->'policy_snapshot'->'required_disciplines' IS DISTINCT FROM policy.material->'required_disciplines'
      OR NOT COALESCE((a->'policy_snapshot'->>'valid_until')::timestamptz<=policy.valid_until,false)
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'after'->'material' IS DISTINCT FROM a->'material'
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'selection'->'units' IS DISTINCT FROM a->'units_snapshot'
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'selection'->'objects' IS DISTINCT FROM a->'object_basis'
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(issue.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions') v
        WHERE (v->>'id')::uuid=(a->>'action_id')::uuid
          AND v->>'executor_id'=a->'material'->>'executor_id')
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM controlled_change_selection_currents c WHERE c.tenant_id=tid
        AND c.product_id=parent.product_id AND c.project_id=parent.project_id
        AND c.change_id=parent.change_id AND c.item_id=(a->>'item_id')::uuid
        AND c.fact_id=target AND c.revision=(a->>'revision')::integer
        AND c.epoch=(a->>'epoch')::integer)
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled selection material/current mismatch'; END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM confirmations WHERE tenant_id=tid
      AND product_id=parent.product_id AND id=(a->>'shared_proof_id')::uuid;
    IF p.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM true OR p.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'actor_id')::uuid
      OR p.operation IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'operation' OR p.subject_id IS DISTINCT FROM parent.product_id
      OR p.revision IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'shared_proof_revision')::integer
      OR p.token_hash IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'token_sha256'
      OR p.payload_digest IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'confirmation_material_sha256'
      OR p.snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM a->'input_snapshot'->'review'
      OR p.created_at>(a->>'proof_consumed_at')::timestamptz
      OR (a->>'proof_consumed_at')::timestamptz>(a->>'created_at')::timestamptz
      OR (a->>'created_at')::timestamptz>=p.expires_at
      OR p.expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'proof_expires_at')::timestamptz
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled selection proof mismatch'; END IF;
    IF (a->'input_snapshot'->'review') - ARRAY['operation','payload_semantic','before','after','read_set','sources','authority','policy','source_basis','selection','effect','unknown','proof_tier'] <> '{}'::jsonb
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(a->'input_snapshot'->'review'))<>13
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'operation'
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->>'proof_tier' IS DISTINCT FROM 'T2'
      OR (a->'input_snapshot'->'shared_proof') IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'tier','T2')
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'before'->>'change_id' IS DISTINCT FROM parent.change_id::text
      OR (a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'before'->>'change_revision')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM parent.revision
      OR (a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'after'->>'selection_revision')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'revision')::integer
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'after'->>'issue_version_id' IS DISTINCT FROM issue.id::text
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'payload_semantic' IS DISTINCT FROM a->'input_snapshot'->'semantic'
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'read_set' IS DISTINCT FROM a->'required_source_read_set'
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'sources' IS DISTINCT FROM a->'sources'
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'source_basis' IS DISTINCT FROM a->'source_basis'
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'authority' IS DISTINCT FROM a->'authority_snapshot'
      OR a->'input_snapshot'->'review'->'policy' IS DISTINCT FROM a->'policy_snapshot'
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled selection exact review mismatch'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF a->'material'->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
       'tenant_id',tid,'product_id',(a->>'product_id')::uuid,'project_id',(a->>'project_id')::uuid)
    OR a->'material'->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'purpose'
    OR jsonb_typeof(a->'sources')<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(a->'sources') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 20
    OR jsonb_typeof(a->'required_source_read_set')<>'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(a->'required_source_read_set') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 20
    OR NOT (a->'sources' @> jsonb_build_array(a->'source'))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled source scope mismatch'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM action_receipts WHERE tenant_id=tid
    AND product_id=(a->>'product_id')::uuid AND operation=a->>'operation'
    AND subject_type=family AND subject_id=target AND subject_revision=(a->>'revision')::integer;
  IF r.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'actor_id')::uuid OR r.requester_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.actor_id
    OR r.run_id IS NOT NULL OR r.command_id IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'command_id')::uuid
    OR r.intent_digest IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'intent_digest'
    OR r.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'visibility'
    OR r.result->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM target::text
    OR (r.result->>'revision')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'revision')::integer
    OR r.result->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'status'
    OR (tab='controlled_change_selection_facts' AND
      (r.result->>'item_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'item_id'
       OR r.result->>'action_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'action_id'
       OR r.result->>'material_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'material_sha256'))
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM request_keys k WHERE k.tenant_id=tid AND k.actor_id=r.actor_id
      AND k.receipt_id=r.id AND k.digest=r.request_digest)
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_entries x WHERE x.tenant_id=tid AND x.receipt_id=r.id
      AND x.actor_id=r.actor_id AND x.operation=r.operation)<>1
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_events x WHERE x.tenant_id=tid AND x.receipt_id=r.id
      AND x.actor_id=r.actor_id AND x.type=effect AND x.subject_id=r.subject_id
      AND x.subject_revision=r.subject_revision AND x.correlation_id=r.command_id)<>1
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled publication common group mismatch'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_controlled_change_atom()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_manufacturing_preparation_atom(t uuid, target uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE v manufacturing_preparation_versions%ROWTYPE;
 c confirmations%ROWTYPE; r action_receipts%ROWTYPE; n integer; expected_event text;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT v FROM manufacturing_preparation_versions WHERE tenant_id=t AND id=target;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM confirmations WHERE tenant_id=t AND id=v.shared_proof_id;
 SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM manufacturing_preparation_versions WHERE tenant_id=t AND
shared_proof_id=c.id;
 IF n<>1 OR c.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM true
    OR ROW(c.product_id,c.actor_id,c.subject_id,c.operation,c.revision)
       IS DISTINCT FROM
ROW(v.product_id,v.owner_id,v.product_id,v.operation,v.shared_proof_revision)
    OR c.token_hash IS DISTINCT FROM v.token_sha256 OR c.payload_digest IS DISTINCT FROM
v.material_sha256
    OR c.snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM v.review OR c.expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM v.proof_expires_at
    OR NOT(c.created_at<=v.proof_consumed_at AND v.proof_consumed_at<=v.created_at AND
v.created_at<c.expires_at)
    OR (SELECT revision FROM products WHERE tenant_id=t AND id=v.product_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
c.revision
    OR v.shared_proof_revision IS DISTINCT FROM c.revision
    OR v.review->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM v.operation
    OR v.review->'after'->>'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM v.revision::text
    OR jsonb_typeof(v.review->'after'->'revision') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR v.review->'after'->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'draft'
    OR v.input_snapshot->'command'->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM v.operation
    OR v.input_snapshot->'command'->>'product_id' IS DISTINCT FROM v.product_id::text
    OR v.input_snapshot->'command'->>'expected_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM c.revision::text
    OR v.input_snapshot->'command'->'payload' IS DISTINCT FROM v.input_snapshot->'semantic'
    OR v.body->'input'->'sources' IS NULL
    OR jsonb_typeof(v.sources) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR jsonb_typeof(v.required_source_read_set) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(v.required_source_read_set)>20
    OR v.body->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM v.kind
    OR v.review->'after'->'body' IS DISTINCT FROM v.body
    OR v.review->'authority' IS DISTINCT FROM v.authority_snapshot
    OR v.review->'read_basis' IS DISTINCT FROM v.source_basis
    OR v.review->'required_source_read_set' IS DISTINCT FROM v.required_source_read_set
    OR v.body->'input' IS DISTINCT FROM v.input_snapshot->'semantic'
    OR v.body->'scope'->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM v.purpose
    OR (SELECT purpose FROM projects WHERE tenant_id=t AND product_id=v.product_id AND
id=v.project_id) IS DISTINCT FROM v.purpose
    OR v.body->'input'->>'project_id' IS DISTINCT FROM v.project_id::text
    OR v.body->'input'->'process' IS DISTINCT FROM
jsonb_build_object('id',v.process_id,'revision',v.process_revision)
    OR v.body->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'draft'
    OR v.body->'input'->>'visibility' IS DISTINCT FROM v.visibility
    OR v.body->'input'->>'title' IS DISTINCT FROM v.title
    OR v.authority_snapshot->>'valid_until' IS NULL
    OR (v.authority_snapshot->>'valid_until')::timestamptz<=v.created_at
    OR v.authority_snapshot->>'subject_id' IS DISTINCT FROM v.owner_id::text
    OR v.authority_snapshot->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM v.operation
    OR v.authority_snapshot->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM v.purpose
    OR v.authority_snapshot->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM
jsonb_build_object('tenant_id',t,'product_id',v.product_id,'project_id',v.project_id)
    OR v.authority_snapshot->'authorized' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
    OR v.authority_snapshot->'qualified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
    OR NOT(v.authority_snapshot->'roles' @> '["manufacturing"]'::jsonb)
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM principals actor WHERE actor.tenant_id=t AND actor.id=v.owner_id
       AND actor.kind='human' AND actor.active IS TRUE) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Preparation original proof, scope and actual material mismatch'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM process_revisions p
   JOIN engineering_configurations e ON e.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND e.product_id=p.product_id
      AND e.id=p.engineering_configuration_id AND e.revision=p.engineering_revision
   JOIN project_product_links l ON l.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND l.product_id=p.product_id AND
l.project_id=v.project_id
   WHERE p.tenant_id=t AND p.product_id=v.product_id AND p.id=v.process_id AND
p.revision=v.process_revision
     AND e.definition_id=l.definition_id AND e.definition_revision=l.definition_revision
     AND (v.visibility='private' OR (p.visibility='product' AND e.visibility='product'))
     AND p.operations IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v.body->'process_snapshot'->'operations') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Preparation actual process/engineering/project binding mismatch'; END IF;
 IF v.kind<>'manufacturing_baseline' THEN
   IF v.body->'input'->>'operation_key' IS DISTINCT FROM v.operation_key OR NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM process_revisions p, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.operations) op
     WHERE p.tenant_id=t AND p.id=v.process_id AND op->>'key'=v.operation_key) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'Preparation operation is not in fixed process'; END IF;
 ELSE
   IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.body->'input'->'operations'))
       <> (SELECT jsonb_array_length(operations) FROM process_revisions WHERE tenant_id=t AND
id=v.process_id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM process_revisions p, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.operations) op
         WHERE p.tenant_id=t AND p.id=v.process_id AND
           (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.body->'input'->'operations') x
             WHERE x->>'operation_key'=op->>'key')<>1)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM manufacturing_baseline_document_links d
         JOIN manufacturing_preparation_versions child ON child.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND
child.id=d.document_id
         WHERE d.tenant_id=t AND d.baseline_id=v.id AND
           (d.project_id<>v.project_id OR d.process_id<>v.process_id OR
d.process_revision<>v.process_revision
            OR d.baseline_revision<>v.revision OR child.kind<>d.document_kind OR
child.revision<>d.document_revision
            OR child.operation_key<>d.operation_key OR child.purpose<>v.purpose
            OR (v.visibility='product' AND child.visibility<>'product')
            OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM manufacturing_preparation_currents cur
                 WHERE cur.tenant_id=t AND cur.version_id=child.id AND
cur.revision=child.revision)))
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM manufacturing_baseline_document_links d WHERE d.tenant_id=t AND
d.baseline_id=v.id)
         <> (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.body->'input'->'operations') op
              CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('work_instruction'),('control_plan')) AS kinds(name)
              WHERE op->kinds.name IS NOT NULL AND op->kinds.name<>'null'::jsonb)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.body->'input'->'operations') op
           CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('work_instruction'),('control_plan')) AS kinds(name)
           WHERE op->kinds.name IS NOT NULL AND op->kinds.name<>'null'::jsonb AND NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT 1 FROM manufacturing_baseline_document_links d WHERE d.tenant_id=t AND
d.baseline_id=v.id
                AND d.operation_key=op->>'operation_key' AND d.document_kind=kinds.name
                AND d.document_id::text=op->kinds.name->>'id'
                AND d.document_revision::text=op->kinds.name->>'revision')) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'Baseline exact whole process and fixed child set mismatch'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF v.body->'input'->>'previous_id' IS DISTINCT FROM v.previous_id::text
 OR v.body->'input'->>'expected_previous_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM v.previous_revision::text
 OR (v.previous_id IS NULL AND v.review->'before' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb)
 OR (v.previous_id IS NOT NULL AND (v.review->'before'->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM v.previous_id::text
 OR v.review->'before'->>'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM v.previous_revision::text)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Preparation previous semantic and actual before material mismatch'; END IF;
 IF v.previous_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM manufacturing_preparation_versions p WHERE p.tenant_id=t AND p.id=v.previous_id
    AND p.series_id=v.series_id AND p.project_id=v.project_id AND p.product_id=v.product_id
    AND p.kind=v.kind AND p.owner_id=v.owner_id AND p.visibility=v.visibility AND
p.purpose=v.purpose
    AND p.revision=v.previous_revision AND v.revision=p.revision+1
    AND p.operation_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v.operation_key
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM process_revisions old_process, process_revisions new_process
      WHERE old_process.tenant_id=t AND new_process.tenant_id=t
        AND old_process.product_id=v.product_id AND new_process.product_id=v.product_id
        AND old_process.id=p.process_id AND old_process.revision=p.process_revision
        AND new_process.id=v.process_id AND new_process.revision=v.process_revision
        AND old_process.series_id=new_process.series_id)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Preparation predecessor full series scope mismatch'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM manufacturing_preparation_currents p WHERE p.tenant_id=t
    AND p.product_id=v.product_id AND p.project_id=v.project_id AND p.kind=v.kind AND
p.series_id=v.series_id
    AND p.owner_id=v.owner_id AND p.visibility=v.visibility AND p.version_id=v.id AND
p.revision=v.revision) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'New preparation requires exact Current'; END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM action_receipts WHERE tenant_id=t AND product_id=v.product_id
   AND subject_type=v.kind AND subject_id=v.id AND subject_revision=v.revision;
 IF n<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Preparation requires one common receipt'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM action_receipts WHERE tenant_id=t AND product_id=v.product_id
   AND subject_type=v.kind AND subject_id=v.id AND subject_revision=v.revision;
 expected_event := CASE v.operation WHEN 'npi.work_instruction.record' THEN
'work_instruction.recorded'
   WHEN 'npi.control_plan.record' THEN 'control_plan.recorded' ELSE
'manufacturing_baseline.recorded' END;
 IF ROW(r.actor_id,r.requester_id,r.visibility,r.operation,r.intent_digest,r.request_digest)
     IS DISTINCT FROM
ROW(v.owner_id,v.owner_id,v.visibility,v.operation,v.intent_digest,v.input_snapshot->>'request_digest')
    OR r.run_id IS NOT NULL OR r.result->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM v.id::text
    OR r.result->>'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM v.revision::text OR r.result->>'status' IS
DISTINCT FROM 'draft'
    OR jsonb_typeof(r.result->'revision') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR r.command_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM v.input_snapshot->'command'->>'command_id'
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_entries a WHERE a.tenant_id=t AND a.receipt_id=r.id)<>1
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_events e WHERE e.tenant_id=t AND e.receipt_id=r.id)<>1
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_entries a WHERE a.tenant_id=t AND a.receipt_id=r.id
         AND a.actor_id=v.owner_id AND a.operation=v.operation)<>1
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_events e WHERE e.tenant_id=t AND e.receipt_id=r.id
         AND e.type=expected_event AND e.actor_id=v.owner_id AND e.subject_id=v.id
         AND e.subject_revision=v.revision AND e.correlation_id=r.command_id)<>1
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM request_keys k WHERE k.tenant_id=t AND k.receipt_id=r.id
         AND k.actor_id=v.owner_id AND k.key=v.input_snapshot->'command'->>'idempotency_key'
         AND k.digest=r.request_digest)<>1 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Preparation receipt/audit/outbox/original request mismatch'; END IF;
END $function$

BEGIN

  AND (value->'key'='null'::jsonb OR
    (jsonb_typeof(value->'key')='string' AND length(value->>'key') BETWEEN 1 AND 120)),false)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage fixed reference shape mismatch'; END IF;
 -- These casts also reject malformed UUIDs and out-of-range revisions.
 RETURN (value->>'kind')||':'||(value->>'id')::uuid::text||':'||
  (value->>'revision')::integer::text||':'||COALESCE(value->>'key','');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_change_coverage_atom(tid uuid, target uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE a public.controlled_change_coverage_facts%ROWTYPE;
 r public.action_receipts%ROWTYPE; origin public.change_request_versions%ROWTYPE;
 anchor public.change_request_versions%ROWTYPE; parent public.change_request_versions%ROWTYPE;
 m jsonb; b jsonb; item jsonb; src jsonb; scope_json jsonb;
 nodes text[]; roots text[]; facet_nodes text[]; unit_nodes text[]; facets text[];
 fixed jsonb; steps integer:=0; native public.artifact_versions%ROWTYPE;
 registration public.action_receipts%ROWTYPE; native_basis jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF tid IS DISTINCT FROM nullif(current_setting('pdos.tenant_id',true),'')::uuid THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage atom tenant mismatch'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM public.controlled_change_coverage_facts
  WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=target;
 m:=a.material; b:=a.input_snapshot->'origin_binding';
 scope_json:=jsonb_build_object('tenant_id',tid,'product_id',a.product_id,'project_id',a.project_id);
 IF NOT COALESCE(public.coverage_json_keys(m,ARRAY['schema_version','scope','purpose',
  'change_id','origin_version_id','origin_revision','owner_id','visibility','publisher_id',
  'roots','nodes','units','facets','closure_sha256','valid_from','valid_until','nature'])
  AND m->>'schema_version'='pdos-controlled-change-coverage-v1'
  AND m->'scope'=scope_json AND m->>'purpose'=a.purpose
  AND (m->>'change_id')::uuid=a.change_id
  AND (m->>'origin_version_id')::uuid=a.origin_version_id
  AND jsonb_typeof(m->'origin_revision')='number'
  AND m->>'origin_revision' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
  AND (m->>'origin_revision')::integer=a.origin_revision
  AND (m->>'owner_id')::uuid=a.owner_id AND m->>'visibility'=a.visibility
  AND (m->>'publisher_id')::uuid=a.actor_id
  AND m->>'closure_sha256'=a.closure_sha256
  AND (m->>'valid_from')::timestamptz=a.valid_from
  AND (m->>'valid_until')::timestamptz=a.valid_until AND m->>'nature'=a.nature
  AND a.operation='change.coverage.import' AND a.status='published'
  AND a.revision=a.epoch AND a.dependency_epoch>0
  AND a.valid_from<=a.created_at AND a.created_at<a.valid_until
  AND a.material_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND a.purpose_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  AND a.intent_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND a.closure_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$',false)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage material/header mismatch'; END IF;
 -- Python's canonical digest is checked by the actual owner, not jsonb::text.
 IF NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(m->'nodes')='array'
  AND jsonb_array_length(m->'nodes') BETWEEN 1 AND 250
  AND jsonb_typeof(m->'roots')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(m->'roots') BETWEEN 1 AND 100
  AND jsonb_typeof(m->'units')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(m->'units') BETWEEN 1 AND 250
  AND jsonb_typeof(m->'facets')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(m->'facets')=8,false)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage bounded enumeration required'; END IF;
 SELECT array_agg(public.coverage_ref_identity(v) ORDER BY public.coverage_ref_identity(v))
  INTO nodes FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'nodes') v;
 SELECT array_agg(public.coverage_ref_identity(v) ORDER BY public.coverage_ref_identity(v))
  INTO roots FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'roots') v;
 IF cardinality(nodes)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT v) FROM unnest(nodes) v)
  OR cardinality(roots)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT v) FROM unnest(roots) v)
  OR NOT roots<@nodes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage node/root enumeration mismatch'; END IF;
 SELECT array_agg(v->>'facet' ORDER BY v->>'facet') INTO facets
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'facets') v;
 IF facets IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['customer_samples','engineering','evidence_applicability',
  'in_process_builds','manufacturing','production_switch','supply_inventory_wip','training']::text[]
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage requires exact eight facets'; END IF;
 FOR item IN SELECT v FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'facets') v LOOP
  IF NOT COALESCE(public.coverage_json_keys(item,ARRAY['facet','nodes','statement'])
   AND jsonb_typeof(item->'nodes')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(item->'nodes') BETWEEN 1 AND 250
   AND jsonb_typeof(item->'statement')='string'
   AND length(btrim(item->>'statement')) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000,false)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage facet declaration required'; END IF;
  SELECT array_agg(public.coverage_ref_identity(v) ORDER BY public.coverage_ref_identity(v))
   INTO facet_nodes FROM jsonb_array_elements(item->'nodes') v;
  IF facet_nodes IS DISTINCT FROM nodes THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'every coverage facet needs the complete fixed node set'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR item IN SELECT v FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'units') v LOOP
  IF NOT COALESCE(public.coverage_json_keys(item,ARRAY['unit','object_identity'])
   AND jsonb_typeof(item->'unit')='string' AND jsonb_typeof(item->'object_identity')='string'
   AND item->>'unit'='object:'||(item->>'object_identity'),false)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage supports exact object units only'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT array_agg(v->>'object_identity' ORDER BY v->>'object_identity') INTO unit_nodes
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'units') v;
 IF unit_nodes IS DISTINCT FROM nodes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage exact units mismatch'; END IF;
 IF NOT COALESCE(public.coverage_json_keys(a.input_snapshot,ARRAY['payload','origin_binding'])
  AND public.coverage_json_keys(a.input_snapshot->'payload',ARRAY['project_id','change_id',
   'purpose','source','expected_previous_id','expected_previous_revision','reason'])
  AND a.input_snapshot->'payload'->>'project_id'=a.project_id::text
  AND a.input_snapshot->'payload'->>'change_id'=a.change_id::text
  AND a.input_snapshot->'payload'->>'purpose'=a.purpose
  AND a.input_snapshot->'payload'->'source'=a.source
  AND jsonb_typeof(a.input_snapshot->'payload'->'reason')='string'
  AND length(btrim(a.input_snapshot->'payload'->>'reason')) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000
  AND public.coverage_json_keys(b,ARRAY['current_id','version_id','revision','origin_version_id',
   'origin_revision','fixed_request']) AND b->>'origin_version_id'=a.origin_version_id::text
  AND (b->>'origin_revision')::integer=a.origin_revision,false)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage exact import/origin binding required'; END IF;
 IF (a.previous_id IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(
    a.input_snapshot->'payload'->'expected_previous_id'='null'::jsonb
    AND a.input_snapshot->'payload'->'expected_previous_revision'='null'::jsonb,false))
  OR (a.previous_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(
    (a.input_snapshot->'payload'->>'expected_previous_id')::uuid=a.previous_id
    AND (a.input_snapshot->'payload'->>'expected_previous_revision')::integer=a.previous_revision,false))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage exact previous publication required'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT origin FROM public.change_request_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid
  AND product_id=a.product_id AND project_id=a.project_id AND change_id=a.change_id
  AND id=a.origin_version_id AND revision=a.origin_revision;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT anchor FROM public.change_request_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid
  AND product_id=a.product_id AND project_id=a.project_id AND change_id=a.change_id
  AND id=(b->>'version_id')::uuid AND revision=(b->>'revision')::integer;
 fixed:=jsonb_build_object('scope',origin.request_snapshot->'scope',
  'audience',origin.request_snapshot->'audience','requester_id',origin.request_snapshot->'requester_id',
  'roots',origin.request_snapshot->'roots','references',origin.request_snapshot->'references');
 IF origin.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.owner_id OR origin.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM a.visibility
  OR fixed IS DISTINCT FROM b->'fixed_request' OR fixed->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM scope_json
  OR fixed->'roots' IS DISTINCT FROM m->'roots' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage exact origin scope/audience/roots required'; END IF;
 parent:=anchor;
 LOOP
  IF parent.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.owner_id OR parent.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM a.visibility
   OR jsonb_build_object('scope',parent.request_snapshot->'scope',
    'audience',parent.request_snapshot->'audience','requester_id',parent.request_snapshot->'requester_id',
    'roots',parent.request_snapshot->'roots','references',parent.request_snapshot->'references')
     IS DISTINCT FROM fixed THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage fixed lineage mismatch'; END IF;
  EXIT WHEN parent.id=a.origin_version_id AND parent.revision=a.origin_revision;
  steps:=steps+1;
  IF steps>=100 OR parent.revision<=a.origin_revision
   OR parent.previous_revision IS DISTINCT FROM parent.revision-1
   OR parent.operation NOT IN ('change.impact.compute','change.order.prepare','change.order.approve',
    'change.implementation.record') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage bounded lineage required'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT parent FROM public.change_request_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid
   AND product_id=a.product_id AND project_id=a.project_id AND change_id=a.change_id
   AND id=parent.previous_version_id AND revision=parent.previous_revision;
 END LOOP;
 IF NOT COALESCE(public.coverage_json_keys(a.issuer_stamp,ARRAY['coverage_epoch','coverage_runtime_id',
  'issuer_key','issuer_version','issuer_epoch','nature','pins_sha256'])
  AND jsonb_typeof(a.issuer_stamp->'coverage_epoch')='number'
  AND a.issuer_stamp->>'coverage_epoch' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
  AND jsonb_typeof(a.issuer_stamp->'issuer_epoch')='number'
  AND a.issuer_stamp->>'issuer_epoch' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
  AND a.issuer_stamp->>'pins_sha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  AND a.issuer_stamp->>'nature'=a.nature
  AND jsonb_typeof(a.issuer_stamp->'issuer_key')='string'
  AND jsonb_typeof(a.issuer_stamp->'issuer_version')='string'
  AND (a.issuer_stamp->>'coverage_runtime_id')::uuid IS NOT NULL
  AND a.authority_snapshot->'scope'=scope_json
  AND a.authority_snapshot->>'subject_id'=a.actor_id::text
  AND a.authority_snapshot->>'operation'='change.impact.compute'
  AND a.authority_snapshot->>'purpose'=a.purpose
  AND a.authority_snapshot->'authorized'='true'::jsonb
  AND a.authority_snapshot->'qualified'='true'::jsonb
  AND a.authority_snapshot->>'facts_revision' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  AND (a.authority_snapshot->>'valid_until')::timestamptz>a.created_at
  AND a.authority_snapshot->'synthetic'=to_jsonb(a.nature='synthetic'),false)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage saved issuer/authority correspondence required'; END IF;
 IF NOT COALESCE(public.coverage_json_keys(a.source,ARRAY['id','revision','kind','position'])
  AND a.source->>'kind'='artifact' AND jsonb_typeof(a.source->'revision')='number'
  AND a.source->>'revision' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
  AND a.source->>'position' ~ '^line:[1-9][0-9]*;quote_sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  AND jsonb_typeof(a.sources)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(a.sources)>=1
  AND a.sources @> jsonb_build_array(a.source)
  AND jsonb_typeof(a.required_source_read_set)='array'
  AND jsonb_array_length(a.required_source_read_set) BETWEEN 1 AND 20
  AND a.source_basis->>'closure_sha256'=a.closure_sha256
  AND (a.source_basis->>'dependency_epoch')::bigint=a.dependency_epoch
  AND a.source_basis->>'temporal_sha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  AND jsonb_typeof(a.source_basis->'artifact_basis')='object'
  AND public.coverage_json_keys(a.source_basis,ARRAY['artifact_basis','closure_sha256',
   'dependency_epoch','temporal_sha256']),false)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage fixed original/read set correspondence required'; END IF;
 FOR src IN SELECT v FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.sources) v LOOP
  IF NOT COALESCE(public.coverage_json_keys(src,ARRAY['id','revision','kind','position'])
   AND (src->>'id')::uuid IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(src->'revision')='number'
   AND src->>'revision' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND src->>'kind' IN ('artifact','domain','command')
   AND jsonb_typeof(src->'position')='string'
   AND length(btrim(src->>'position')) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000,false)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage source reference shape mismatch'; END IF;
  IF src->>'kind'='artifact' AND NOT a.required_source_read_set @>
    jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('artifact_id',src->>'id','expected_revision',(src->>'revision')::integer))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage original source must be in exact read set'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF jsonb_array_length(a.sources)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT v) FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.sources) v)
  OR jsonb_array_length(a.required_source_read_set)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT v->>'artifact_id')
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.required_source_read_set) v)
  OR jsonb_array_length(a.required_source_read_set)<>(SELECT count(*)
    FROM jsonb_object_keys(a.source_basis->'artifact_basis'))
  OR NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(a.authority_snapshot->'required_source_read_set')='array'
   AND a.required_source_read_set @> (a.authority_snapshot->'required_source_read_set'),false)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage duplicate/mixed authority read set'; END IF;
 FOR item IN SELECT v FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.required_source_read_set) v LOOP
  IF NOT COALESCE(public.coverage_json_keys(item,ARRAY['artifact_id','expected_revision'])
   AND (item->>'artifact_id')::uuid IS NOT NULL
   AND jsonb_typeof(item->'expected_revision')='number'
   AND item->>'expected_revision' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
   AND a.source_basis->'artifact_basis' ? (item->>'artifact_id')
   AND (a.source_basis->'artifact_basis'->(item->>'artifact_id')->>'revision')::integer
    =(item->>'expected_revision')::integer,false)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage exact artifact basis required'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Scope/registration correspondence only: later withdrawal does not erase a
 -- stored publication, and original-byte authenticity remains owner verified.
 SELECT * INTO STRICT native FROM public.artifact_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid
  AND product_id=a.product_id AND id=(a.source->>'id')::uuid;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT registration FROM public.action_receipts x WHERE x.tenant_id=tid
  AND x.product_id=a.product_id AND x.operation='evidence.artifact.register'
  AND x.subject_type='artifact' AND x.subject_id=native.id
  AND x.subject_revision=(a.source->>'revision')::integer;
 native_basis:=a.source_basis->'artifact_basis'->(a.source->>'id');
 IF NOT COALESCE(native_basis->>'source_origin'='registered_native_text'
   AND native_basis->>'registration_receipt_id'=registration.id::text
   AND native_basis->>'registration_command_id'=registration.command_id::text
   AND native_basis->>'registration_actor_id'=registration.actor_id::text
   AND native_basis->>'registration_requester_id'=registration.requester_id::text
   AND native_basis->'registration_run_id'=COALESCE(to_jsonb(registration.run_id::text),'null'::jsonb)
   AND native_basis->>'registration_request_digest'=registration.request_digest
   AND native_basis->>'registration_intent_digest'=registration.intent_digest
   AND native_basis->>'sha256'=native.content_hash
   AND registration.requester_id=native.owner_id AND registration.visibility=native.visibility
   AND registration.result->>'id'=native.id::text
   AND (registration.result->>'revision')::integer=registration.subject_revision
   AND registration.result->>'status'='active',false)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage requires exact native original registration'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM public.action_receipts WHERE tenant_id=tid
  AND product_id=a.product_id AND operation='change.coverage.import'
  AND subject_type='change_coverage_fact' AND subject_id=a.id AND subject_revision=a.revision;
 IF r.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.actor_id OR r.requester_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.actor_id
  OR r.run_id IS NOT NULL OR r.command_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.command_id
  OR r.intent_digest IS DISTINCT FROM a.intent_digest OR r.request_digest IS DISTINCT FROM a.intent_digest
  OR r.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM a.visibility OR r.result IS DISTINCT FROM
    jsonb_build_object('id',a.id::text,'revision',a.revision,'status',a.status)
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.audit_entries x WHERE x.tenant_id=tid AND x.receipt_id=r.id)<>1
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.audit_entries x WHERE x.tenant_id=tid AND x.receipt_id=r.id
   AND x.actor_id=r.actor_id AND x.operation=r.operation)
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.outbox_events x WHERE x.tenant_id=tid AND x.receipt_id=r.id)<>1
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.outbox_events x WHERE x.tenant_id=tid AND x.receipt_id=r.id
   AND x.actor_id=r.actor_id AND x.type='change.coverage_imported' AND x.subject_id=a.id
   AND x.subject_revision=a.revision AND x.schema_version=1 AND x.correlation_id=r.command_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.request_keys k WHERE k.tenant_id=tid AND k.receipt_id=r.id
   AND k.actor_id=r.actor_id AND k.digest=r.request_digest)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.request_keys k WHERE k.tenant_id=tid AND k.receipt_id=r.id
   AND (k.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.actor_id OR k.digest IS DISTINCT FROM r.request_digest))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage requires one exact immutable common group'; END IF;
END $function$
